chapters.title: Chapter 101: Preparing the Ingredients
paragraphs: "So... Begin by heating the water in a large pot, adding the carnivore rabbit bones, slime extract, garlic, ginger, onion, and dried mushrooms. Bring it to a boil, stirring occasionally to dissolve the slime extract fully," Kaiden read the instructions from Madame Spice’s book utterly shamelessly, making Sarah giggle, "Hehehe! He truly had no clue at all! I knew it; he’s winging it!"

"Yes, Chef!" Aria shouted merrily and brought out a big pot, filled it with water, and put it on the stove. Luna, meanwhile, moved to grab the bones and slime extract. Nyx elected to begin chopping. Since her part took longer, the other two soon joined her in the cutting duties.

While they were busy with the preparations, Kaiden put on a pleasant background music track that made the atmosphere of the stream even better. It had a very nice vibe to it, Sarah thought, as she licked her spoon clean of any remaining N*tella.
"Slime extract... We just started cooking, but I already don’t wanna taste it..." Luna grumbled under her breath in her typical adorable manner.
"I heard it’s an ingredient that elevates many meals to the next level," Nyx responded.

"Alright. It says... While the broth simmers, take all of the proteins and thinly slice them into even, bite-sized pieces. Arrange them on separate plates for easy access," Kaiden continued once they were done.
"Master- I mean, Chef, you should introduce the meats!" Nyx nudged.

Kaiden nodded, cleared his throat dramatically, and gestured toward the counter where the selected meats were arranged in simple trays. "Ladies and gentlemen, allow Master Chef Kaiden to present our premium selection of dungeon delicacies. Feast your eyes on these horribly expensive, overpriced proteins!"
Nyx simply grinned at her lover’s antics, Luna muttered something about "boundless shamelessness," while Aria clapped enthusiastically.

"First!" Kaiden dramatically pointed to the tray containing reddish-pink meat. "The infamous carnivorous rabbit whose bones we already used for the broth! Don’t let its size fool you—this creature of terror can bite through steel. However, its corpse provides tender, lean meat with a mild, gamey flavor. A classic of dungeon cuisine!"

He moved on to the next tray, which featured chunks of light blue meat. "Next, we have glowfin eel! Known for its mesmerizing glow in shallow dungeon streams, this slippery creature offers a delicate, sweet taste."
- TouchGrass: Are we sure eel and rabbit are supposed to go in the same pot?
- Kaiden’s Wife: Kai knows best; don’t ask stupid questions.

- Divine Light: I once shat myself in a dungeon and went to take a dip in the nearby river, that’s when this eel attacked my jewel sack... Every day, I wake up and immediately say a prayer to all that is holy for the presence of a healer in our team that day.
- DeleteYuumi: yikes.

Kaiden stepped to the third tray, where dark, rich-looking meat sat. "Now, the star of the show: razor warthog! If you’ve watched my dungeon stream—of which you can watch a very cool edited video after this stream ends—you would know this monster type was my first kill! While considered a weak monster, its meat has a strong, earthy flavor that’s unmatched by any other beast of its rank. It’s hearty, savory, and just what we need to balance out the flavors in our pot."
He parted his arms wide apart, gesturing at the plates. "There you have it, ladies and gentlemen: our lineup of monster meats for today’s meal!"
Aria clapped excitedly again. "Chef, I can’t wait to try them all!"
Luna sighed as she grabbed a knife and muttered, "I’ll just order takeout."

Kaiden wasn’t having it. "As the man of this household, the duty of ensuring my ladies eat a healthy diet falls to me, so no takeouts today! We eat what we make." He then whispered in a low tone, "I will cry myself to sleep if we have to spend more money on food today."

Nyx began slicing the warthog meat into smaller chunks while saying, "I would be careful with my words if I were you. Assistants shouldn’t anger the chef, or he will start shouting obscenities at his pitiful cooks like all the good chefs do."
"It’s only that one arrogant British dude... If he tried speaking like that to me, I would beat him up."
Their banter continued as the girls began preparing the plates with varying levels of enthusiasm.
"The broth already smells so good!" Nyx spoke up as she hungrily inhaled some warm air escaping from the pot.
"Great. Form three stations. Each of you will be responsible for cutting a monster up."
The girls did as instructed, and Kaiden began making rounds between the three to examine their handiworks.

He started with Luna, who chose the rabbit to work with. She was sulking a bit due to having been denied the opportunity to order restaurant food, so Kaiden evidently decided to cheer her up. Sarah saw the man move behind the Supreme Empress, only to hug her. He rested his hands on her belly while laying some loving smooches on her lush, purple hair.
"He’s so sweet..." Sarah whispered dreamily. She was having amazing fun watching the show, it improved her mood greatly.
- Kaiden’s Wife: Ugh! I’m so jealous!! Wish I could be there too...
- TouchGrass: Simping for online personalities never ends well.
- Thirsty247: Shut up, nerd.
"It’ll be tasty, I’m sure of it. Don’t worry your little head about such things," Kaiden said once he was done kissing her head.
"I’m sorry, I’m not mad about the food or anything... It’s just..." Luna replied in a soft tone, making Sarah think the girl must’ve felt like she was being unreasonable.
"Yes?" Kaiden prodded for answers.
"... I didn’t like your interactions with the pink bimbo." After some great inner deliberations, she revealed what caused her to be grumpy.

"Hehe! So that’s what it was. I understand her completely..." Sarah mused once she finally understood—Luna was agitated because Kaiden got utterly mesmerized by Nyx’s very heavily bouncing breasts when she was asking her question.

"Ah. That was my bad, most certainly," Kaiden nodded along sagely before saying, "But we’ve been through this dance before. I told you already that chest size matters little to me. What’s truly important is the woman they’re attached to, and you are one wonderful woman."
Sarah gasped at his unexpected declaration, and she didn’t seem to be alone.
- Kaiden’s Wife: Yesssssss!!!!! I knew Kai wasn’t a shallow man like the others! There’s more to us than the measurements of our chest!

"Bastard, you’re saying one thing and then doing another!" Luna accused before taking on a deep, manly tone to imitate Kaiden, "I don’t care about a girl’s bust size..." She then turned toward Nyx, who was watching the whole thing going down with amused eyes, and Luna started ogling her bazookas. "Yeah, my beloved little Luna, I swear I don’t care, not at all, but let me just stare at my cow-uddered girlfriend—who very obviously displays her inflated wares deliberately, without an ounce of shame in her entire being—for a few seconds as if I’m currently seeing the world’s most beautiful sight. But I still love you just as much as I love her though. I swear on everything that is holy."

chapters.title: Chapter 102: Teaching New Tricks to an Old Dog
paragraphs: Sarah nearly choked on her spoonful Nut*lla as she immediately burst out into hearty laughter. "Tell him, Supreme Empress!"
- Corn Addict: Kekeke! Caught red-handed, are we, my friend?
- Kaiden’s Wife: I must admit she brings up a valid point...

- Divine Light: When dealing with women, you gotta nod and apologize, no matter what nonsense they are spouting. That is, if you want to have at least a modicum of chance of getting head in the next decade. Take this experienced man’s wisdom to heart. Your lives will be much easier if you do so, youngsters.
- Shadow Warrior: Experienced? You mean old?
- Divine Light: Shadow Warrior, huh. Let me see if you have an internet account, then I’ll ask a few acquaintances to research your details so we can finish this chat in person.
- Shadow Warrior: Experienced senior, this witless junior is apologizing on his trembling knees!
- Divine Light: Hmph.

"I never said I don’t like voluptuous girls," Kaiden spoke up in his defense, "Just that I appreciate all forms of feminine curves equally. Nyx is a bombshell who sometimes makes me forget even my name, but so do you. You should know better than anyone how much I appreciate your breathtakingly gorgeous body."

"Hmm..." Luna didn’t respond with words but thought inwardly for a few seconds before turning around and giving him a big, needy hug. "I accept defeat. You are right, I was being jealous for no reason. I’m superior as a woman, as a person, as a combatant, as an entertainer—it’s stupid of me to feel lesser."
"Hey now, I didn’t say that..." Kaiden replied wryly while eyeing Nyx, who had a sinister smile emerge on her lips as she stared at the purple-haired woman nuzzling her head into his chest.

- Divine Light: Damn! Not apologizing but instead bringing her up to the same level as the woman she was jealous of. What a smart lad; I approve! It seems that even at this age, I can still learn new things. I’ll try it with the missus the next time she throws a hissy fit, I’m tired of getting on my knees.
Divine Light donated 10 Chronos!
A golden notification popped up with a soft chime. On the mental screen of the viewers, projected directly from their very soul, animated coins danced across to celebrate the donation.
"What the hell?! That’s 1,000 dollars!" Sarah exclaimed in shock.
- Shadow Warrior: W-wait, maybe the senior truly is an awakened!
- Thirsty247: There’s nothing on his profile, but awakened can make money from clearing dungeons, they don’t need to video record it...
People could change their profile names on the awakened media platform, but they could not have multiple profiles. This meant that Divine Light didn’t record a single video.
"Kai, can you check if I’m doing well?" Aria spoke up suddenly, grabbing his attention.

"Oh! Thanks, Divine Light! I wasn’t paying attention. And that’s right, you should never apologize to your women unless you’re truly at fault. They’re like piranhas—if you give them an opening, they will eat you alive. Even a single apology when it’s not you who’s in the wrong will let them know they can walk all over you, at which point correcting their behavior will become an arduous undertaking.
- Divine Light: *Hurriedly taking notes*
- Divine Light: Your wisdom belies your youthful age, junior! You’ll make it far in life.
Divine Light donated 5 Chronos!
- DeleteYuumi: Senior Light, I can also bestow such wise teaching upon you, and I only ask for 5 bucks!
- Divine Light: Let’s hear it then, bucko.
- DeleteYuumi: Wait, I’m not ready like this! I need some time to research.
- Divine Light: The clock is ticking, bucko. 3 seconds.
- Divine Light: 2
- Divine Light: 1
- DeleteYuumi: Agh... I can’t do this!
- DeleteYuumi: Fuck...! My inner demons come out when I’m under pressure! Aghhh!!!
- DeleteYuumi: #Hitlerdidnothingwrong
DeleteYuumi left the stream.
Princeless Princess permanently banned DeleteYuumi.
The chat exploded with a wave of confusion, emojis, and multiple temporary mutes being handed out to other ’eager chatters.’ Kaiden, however, remained calmly focused as if he’d seen it all before.

While the chat was going through a bit of chaos, Kaiden moved to Aria as requested. "You’re doing very well," he stated, but his answer didn’t seem to satisfy the girl, who meaningfully raised her arms toward the ceiling as if to signal something. She looked at him expectantly.

"Oh." Kaiden soon realized what was going on and moved behind the girl, hugging her from behind just as he did with Luna. Once his hands were on her belly, a satisfied smile emerged on Aria’s lips before she lowered her hands and resumed cutting the meat.
However, she wasn’t done just yet—the Moon Valkyrie tip-toed as another silent request of hers was sent to her boyfriend, who received it and acted immediately, laying a kiss on her lush silver hair.
- Thirsty247: #AriaSupremacy
- Shadow Warrior: #AriaSupremacy
- Corn Addict: #AriaSupremacy
It took Kaiden over five minutes to detach from his Moon Valkyrie as, up until that point, every time he did so, she would start whimpering like a love-starved puppy.
Next came Nyx, and because of her racy outfit, he was getting to touch her skin directly.
"Alright, you’ve all got your deserved pampering sessions. Now, let’s finish things by cutting the boar." Kaiden decreed once he was done delivering Nyx’s well-deserved cuddling.
"Yes, Chef!" Three cheery girls voiced their agreement, now they were all feeling butterflies in their stomachs.

Aria even did a little spin on her heels from joy while Nyx licked her lips, clearly excited for the next step of the cooking process. Luna simply nodded with dignified grace, but her twitching ears gave her excitement away.

"Good job. Master Chef Kaiden is proud of his cooks; you all did well. Let’s set up the table and dig in. The viewers who would like to watch my reaction, please switch to Nyx’s stream; she will be sitting in front of me."
Sarah immediately made the switch, and the cooking stream entered its final phase, where an unexpected guest would make an appearance!

chapters.title: Chapter 103: An Unexpected Guest
paragraphs: Kaiden brought out a portable stove and placed the bubbling pot with the unique broth onto it. He was very happy with how the stream was going. They took a big gamble this time around due to the price of food being much higher than their expected financial returns, but a rich dude decided to help them out. The viewer donated 15 Chronos, which was already more than the cost of today’s stream.

Naturally, they would’ve been fine even if the stream ended up in the deep red. The four of them wanted to diversify their content no matter what, and this seemed to be the right move. The goal was to grow and have fun with the process, even if it meant taking some risks. None of them believed that they could achieve what they wanted without taking risks.
Furthermore, all of them were very curious to learn how monsters tasted. Kaiden wanted to feed his lovers with a healthy, unique meal, so he was hitting multiple birds with a single stone.

"So... This Master Chef might not have had enough money to buy dungeon ingredients for the side dishes... As a result, we’ll be having normal greens and mushrooms from good old reliable Earth," Kaiden said with a bit of embarrassment as he sat down at the table. The simmering hot pot was surrounded by numerous plates of raw food that they would cook now.

"It’s totally fine, Kai! I’m so happy just looking at all this food! I never saw so much on a table at once!" Aria decreed as she plopped down next to Kai. Kaiden winced at her words for a single moment because it once again displayed how poor of a household she came from.
"I wonder how the different meats will taste!" Nyx shouted enthusiastically as she grabbed her chopsticks and placed numerous types of food onto her plate, one after the other.

"Here are some dipping sauces," Kaiden stated after he came back from his little trip to the fridge. He forgot the sauces in there. One was a citrus herb oil mix, another was a peanut dipping sauce, and the last one was a soy-sesame mixture.
- Kaiden’s Wife: Hehe! Kai, would a pro chef really use premade sauces for his meal?
"Hey, aren’t you my wife? Wives should be the supportive pillars their husbands can rely on during times of hardships, not their biggest critics."
- Kaiden’s Wife: !!!
- Kaiden’s Wife: Kyaaa!!!
- Kaiden’s Wife: He-he-he called me his wife...!!!
- Kaiden’s Wife: You’re right! I’ll fight the whole world for you, Kai!
- Princeless Princess: Stop spamming! Especially such nonsense at that; he was obviously joking.
- Lady Leia: Yeah, shut your trap, you delusional b*tch.
- Kaiden’s Wife: Jealousy is an ugly trait. Hmph!

Kaiden shook his head amusedly while he read the catfight going on in his chat. The ladies were all having their amicable chat in Nyx’s stream, but since the two were joined under Valhalla’s Sinners, he could merge the chats into one.
Kaiden gestured for the girls to start digging in.

"I gotta start with the warthog. It’s my first kill, after all," Kaiden said while he eagerly started fishing for a boar slice in the pot. Once he got it, he dipped it in citrus sauce and took a bite. He couldn’t help but stare at his empty chopsticks where the meat slice had been with a dumbfounded expression. "Holy hell, this is so good! Madame Spice is a certified genius."

"Mmm!!" Aria squealed excitedly. Her mouth was full, and she was a good girl who wouldn’t part her lips when food was in her mouth, so her joyous sounds were muffled, but her expression told Kaiden all he needed to know.
"I never tried eel before, but I’m sure none from Earth can compare to this one..." Luna whispered as she hungrily dove in for another eel slice.
"Hey, leave some of that for Kai. I heard eels help men down there. He’ll need it for later today," Nyx stated with a coy purr.
"Watch your mouth, woman. You’re insulting me right now."

"Kya! I’m so sorry, master!" Nyx giggled as she raised her two hands in surrender, but her stomach grumbled immediately, so she stopped playing and went for a rabbit slice. Once it reached her tantalizing lips, she had a pure, orgasmic face before she squealed in joy just like Aria did.
A sudden notification brought Kaiden out of his merry staring at his overly expressive girlfriends.
Madame Spice donated 20 Chronos.

- Madame Spice: My daughter told me that her husbando—whatever that means—was streaming monster cooking while using my recipe book, so I came to check you out. It was exceptional for his low level and possibly record-breaking, considering his bottom-of-the-barrel class tier.

However, the numbers weren’t adding up. Kaiden thought that Agility was the most important stat, at least while starting out, so he put 3 into that and 2 into the other physical stats.’Then how on Earth did my Strength and Endurance increase by an extra point?’he pondered inwardly before glancing around his room, namely at the three exhausted women, and it dawned on him.

Kaiden went so hardcore yesterday that it was worth numerous long and excruciating gym sessions! His base stats, meaning the stats he would have if he regressed back to level 1 and lost his invested points, had gone up from the many hours he spent plowing his girls’ fertile flower fields!

He found it so amusing that he had to snicker. Whether it was a conscious ’shut up!’ or she just reacted in her sleep, he didn’t know, but Kaiden received another kick to his stomach from his purple-haired lover. He examined her face for a short bit, coming to the conclusion that she showed no signs of it being done on purpose, or her being awake for that matter. Therefore, Kaiden decided to forego dishing out a morning spanking session.
His reactionary flinch caused Nyx to murmur something in her sleep and she tried to turn away from him, but due to his head weighing down on her plump butt, she couldn’t, so she just lazily gave up.
Now it was time to move on to his other notifications.
He first checked out his new sin stance. The one he gained from ranking his system up was Gluttony, and Kaiden couldn’t help but gasp. This one was so damn powerful already!

[Harvest: A passive ability that’s available no matter the stance the Paragon of Sin is currently in. Slain enemies drop an essence orb upon their death. This orb is only visible to the Paragon of Sin. Being in the vicinity of an orb, it will be automatically picked up by the class’ holder. Each orb provides a small stat buff. The orbs will be lost upon exiting combat for longer than 5 minutes.]

[Devouring Strike: Perform a powerful strike that deals damage and heals the Paragon of Sin. Both the amount of damage dealt and health restored depends on the number of harvested essence orbs. Lose a set amount of essence orbs.]

[Ravenous Bite: Grow sharp fangs and perform a bite attack on a target, siphoning health and mana from them. Only works on living targets. Passive effect: The Paragon of Sin is immune to diseases transmitted through blood.]

Kaiden instantly fell in love with this stance. When he read the stance’s name, he thought he would be forced to eat food in the middle of combat like a pig or something similarly ridiculous, but this was just badass.

Since his stances were restricted and would slowly be less and less restricted as he leveled up, his Gluttony stance would make him into something like a vampire lord down the line, while his Wrath stance was going to become the proper destructive one fit for a demon lord.

[Harvest] had an innate synergy with [Devouring Strike]. Without the former, the latter was useless. [Ravenous Bite], meanwhile, had no synergy with [Harvest], but it was a very cool ability nonetheless. He hoped his awesome Space Valkyrie would one day grow strong enough to restrict their enemies with her [Telekinesis] or other crowd control spells so that he could just walk up and drain them of their blood.
Now that would be a badass display of power from Valhalla’s Sinners.

Kaiden instantly understood how he was meant to use his two stances. It was best to start out with Wrath and lay waste to his enemies, hopefully stacking his [Harvest] up in the meantime. Whenever he was in trouble, he would switch to Gluttony and regenerate his health, becoming something like a high damage-dealing drain tank.

He couldn’t help but wonder what his tier would be now if he returned for a re-evaluation at the association. Kaiden guessed something like a C-tier. While the synergy was there, at the end of the day, his abilities were still rather basic. Now, his next upgrade would likely come from reaching level 25 and upgrading his two stances, or perhaps the next system rank-up would come sooner?
Speaking of which...
[To rank the system up to the third rank, the host needs to reach...]
[Views: 100 million]
[Fangirls: 5,000]
[Income: 10,000]
[Missions]
1. Moon Valkyrie’s Troubles.

’Ouch. Yep, this will take a while.’Kaiden grimaced once he saw the requirements. Although becoming stronger was his main goal, he would take these challenges at the rate he thought most ideal. Panicking and mass releasing porn was not the way to rank his system all the way to the top, it would only help him reach short-term goals but then quite possibly ruin his long-term opportunities.
’Now what’s this quest?’he murmured inwardly while focusing on it for more details.

[Main Mission: Moon Valkyrie’s Troubles: The Successor chose the path of ’Mine And Mine Alone,’ the harem path that allowed him to have Valkyries. The Successor must ensure their continued happiness. The Moon Valkyrie’s home situation is concerning. Solve it.]
[Rewards]
1: Random Skill Card
2: Upgrade Point
’Nice, I was going to do this anyhow.’Kaiden nodded appreciatively toward the quest the system gave him.
He would soon set off to meet Aria’s mother, a meeting that would end up becoming much more complicated than he ever thought possible.

chapters.title: Chapter 111: Visiting the Slums
paragraphs: It took the girls an hour to wake up, which gave Kaiden some time to check out the other creators on the media platform.

He had to wince when he saw ChronosX, which had uploaded a video 20 minutes ago, yet it already had 13 million views. The reach of the system was a mighty one. Illiterate tribesmen who had no clue what even electricity was, let alone the internet, were among the members of the possible audience, which put into perspective just how much room for growth Valhalla’s Sinners had. They were pulling in great numbers when one considered the internet as a basis for comparison, but the media platform was different.

Kaiden checked the page of ChronosX and saw their total view count to be already higher than Earth’s populace, more than three times at that. They had a little over 20 billion combined views spread across 80 videos. Yes, their videos were averaging 250 million views, and they were only a couple of days old at most.

He checked some videos out and they were the same generic slop porn as all others. A boring intro with cringeworthy prewritten dialogues followed by obvious fake moaning and orgasming. The actors and actresses had no personalities, they were just pieces of meat who were most certainly instructed by the director to moan like pigs.

Kaiden also noticed that their newest videos were shot exclusively by their high-quality third-person cameras. ChronosX seemingly returned the first-person camera to the labs for further improvements. It was a smart move on their part, Kaiden thought. If they kept trying to compete with him in the first-person footage, they would just get humiliated each time a viewer compared the content.

Focusing on their strength and choosing to ignore a small channel like theirs was the best move they could have made. They could then turn their staggering amount of profits into more R&D and then begin pushing him out of the market completely once they had a similarly well-functioning first-person camera.

Kaiden also had to grit his teeth when he saw just how many other channels popped up after purchasing the $300,000 cameras, showcasing the incredible bank ChronosX was currently making. They were almost certainly the most profitable company right now. Only a few other giants could take them on, mostly ones focusing on crafting awakened gear. A high-tier blacksmith-type classed person was a straight-up goldmine; their creations would be sold like hotcakes with easily a 1000% return on investment.
The issue blacksmiths faced was the time required to create good gear, but ChronosX could shit out their videos at an incredible rate. They already released 80 in less than three days, after all.

Naturally, high-tier guilds like New Dawn were still having higher incomes than ChronosX, but it was not fair to compare a top guild with a company. A guild like New Dawn had numerous revenue streams and also had many high-tier awakened rampaging in newly formed dungeons, bringing out insane treasures.

Just when Kaiden was done with his musings, the ladies woke up. They did so one after the other in rapid succession as if they were part of a hivemind—which they might’ve been, considering yesterday’s coordinated attack on his person, mainly on his little brother.

"Hmm... *Yawn*" Nyx moaned rather sensually. "Oh, so this is why I couldn’t turn... How was your Valkyrie pillow for the night, master?" the plump beauty asked once she realized his head was resting on her behind.
"Simply the best."
"Hehe!"
"Oh, Kai, I’m so sorry! Are your legs okay? Are they not numb?" Aria awoke with a yelp once she realized she had spent the night sprawled over his legs.
"I’m perfectly fine."
"My body hurts like hell..." Luna grumbled while massaging her thighs.
"Kai certainly did a number on us!" Aria giggled cheerily before planting a loving kiss on the tip of his limp shaft.

Kaiden could go to war once again if he wanted to, but he had other plans, so he stroked Aria’s hair lovingly before giving her head a gentle nudge. "Well, ladies. I’m going to have a chat with Mommy Aria, and do you know what you three will be doing?"
"Cooking pancakes," Nyx replied.
"Reaching Challenger rank," Luna added.

"Probably doing my makeup and then reading my favorite BL mangas’ newest Chapters..." Aria murmured dreamily. It seemed she was still a sucker for that genre even after getting into a proper relationship. Kaiden didn’t mind; she could read her gay stories as much as she liked.
However, not now.
"Beep! Wrong answers!" he decreed while crossing his arms into an X shape. "You three will shower, eat some filling, healthy breakfast, and hit the gym under Miss Aria’s careful guidance."
His announcement sent a ripple of effects across his audience.

Nyx painfully groaned from behind him. "I know this was exactly what I asked for in the dungeon, but now that it’s actually time to fulfill my promise of taking good care of my body, I just want to crash and burn. Warm waffles with jam and steaming hot chocolate to drink, please!"
"Bruh, I’ll die. I can barely move," Luna decreed while glaring at him with eyes full of protest.
"I’m in!" Aria squealed excitedly.
"The best time to start was yesterday, but the second best time is right now!" Kaiden shouted his motivational quote.
"I feel like kicking you in the balls all of a sudden..." Luna growled rather cutely, or so it appeared to Kaiden.
"Luna, you fight with a sword... You need physical stats the most out of us girls," Aria informed the protesting Valkyrie.

"Well, I’m getting a shower first, and then I’m off. Aria, please send me a message with your mother’s home and work addresses," Kaiden said before rushing off into the bathroom. He didn’t want to tell his girls that his system ranked up, and thus they had new spells to them if their theory was correct. He wanted to see how long it would take for them to realize it on their own.
It took Kaiden a good few minutes to navigate the slums until he reached the address. Go*gle Maps didn’t even know the location existed.
Kaiden then spent five minutes or so knocking on the door until he gave up and decided to visit her place of employment—namely, her abusive boyfriend’s brothel.
Once he finally found it, he had to frown. This was one ugly, decaying building.
The walls, which might have been white a long time ago, were now filthy and stained with chunks of it outright missing, exposing the bricks beneath.

The windows were either cracked, completely broken, or boarded up with planks. The roof was also a mess, with missing tiles and randomly placed tarps held down by bricks. Above the doorway, a sign stated "Paradise Den," though some of the letters were gone, forcing Kaiden to spend a few seconds trying to understand what it was meant to say.

"Yikes." Kaiden couldn’t help exclaim. That word perfectly summed up his whirlwind of thoughts into a single phrase. He rather reluctantly stepped in, and the disgusting stench, which most likely resulted from horrible plumbing work, welcomed him. A man with crooked teeth and an ugly smile welcomed him.

chapters.title: Chapter 112: Julia Levander
paragraphs: He stood behind a desk, so Kaiden thought he might be the receptionist.
"Morning," The man spat, letting Kaiden know hospitality was not a strong suit of this establishment.
"Morning. I’m looking to speak with another receptionist working here."
"Another receptionist?" the man asked back with a tone that suggested Kaiden was speaking a foreign language.
"Yeah?" Kaiden was surprised. Aria said her mother worked here as a receptionist. If her colleague didn’t know her, then just what the hell was going on?
"Let’s clear this thing up. You got a name?"
"Julia Levander."
The man smirked upon hearing his words. "Thought so. She was fired, or should I say demoted?" He then started chuckling ominously under his breath, letting his ugly, rotting teeth show.
"... Demoted?" Kaiden couldn’t help but feel that something was horribly wrong here.
"Just this morning, the boss had enough of her. She’s one of the working girls now."
"I still wish to speak with her."
"Speak?"
"Yeah, I’m not interested in her services."

He shook his head and had an annoyed tone to his voice as if Kaiden was a pest he wanted to get rid of. "No can do. Pay for an hour or wait until her shift ends. Though she might just pass out in her room after getting high, most of the workers do that."
"..." Kaiden was shocked at his attitude, while the words he spouted made his heart ache. These people were utterly miserable. "Alright, how much?"

"You’ll be her first customer, so there’s a big premium on her services... or so I would say, but that one is about to get past its expiry date, I’m afraid. I would try to direct your attention to another whore but since you’re not here for that type of a visit I will not do so. She costs $30 for an hour."

Kaiden couldn’t help but raise an eyebrow at her price. This woman was selling her soul for such a meager amount? She would make more as a waitress, and that was if she got to keep all of the money he paid for her time, which was entirely unrealistic. She was working under the minimum wage and most likely by quite a bit at that.
"I see...
The ’receptionist’ then pushed a button, most likely to let her know a customer was coming up so she could make whatever last-minute preparations she needed to.
Kaiden then made his way up the stairs with a grim expression. This place was just pure misery. He knocked on the door as he was instructed to, and a faint "Come in" sounded from the other side.
He took a deep breath, preparing himself mentally, and then opened the door. His heart instantly contorted to a horrible degree.
A woman stood in front of him who was very clearly Aria’s mother. The resemblance was uncanny, but Kaiden felt like he was watching a ’bad end’ route to Aria’s story when he laid eyes on her mother.

Julia was all skin and bones, so much so that calling her anorexic would be generous. Her long, silvery hair was ragged and started losing its unique color as it was turning grey instead. Her exhausted eyes had big, dark circles under them, and there were no signs of life in them.
Back when the man down below called her an ’expiring product,’ Kaiden naively thought he meant she was getting on in age, but that was the least of her problems.

This was a dying woman. Her frailty was so pronounced it was hard to imagine she had ever been a vibrant person, let alone someone who could have had children. Her gaunt cheeks and hollowed eyes made her look more like a corpse than a mother.

"Is there an issue? You can still request someone else..." Julia dejectedly murmured under her breath once he was staring at her for way too long. Seeing he was reluctant to leave, she assumed he was here to stay, so the woman reached for her robe and began parting it alongside a heavy sigh.
Kaiden had two routes he could take.
The kind one or the harsh one.

As far as he was concerned, this was a mother who abandoned her children to pursue her drug addiction, so he went with the latter one, no matter how much it hurt him to see a ruined version of Aria be in even more pain than she already was. Kaiden had to get to the bottom of things, and he thought this was the best path he could take.

To that end, he sat down in a chair nearby, making Julia eye him with confusion. Kaiden followed up by speaking in a distant, authoritative tone. "Stop disrobing yourself, I’m not here for pleasure. I just wanted to see the failure of a mother who abandoned her three children."

Julia’s eyes immediately widened. She took an instinctive step back, but then her spunk returned. "I-I will not be spoken to like that!" she shouted and turned to leave, but then Kaiden raised his voice once again with an even more hostile tone. "I bet you didn’t even know thatyouractions had forced Aria Levander to sell her virginity so that she could take care ofyourchildren, did you?"

Kaiden’s words made the miserable woman freeze in place for a good five seconds before she turned toward him with slow, robotic motions. Julia mutely stared at him with eyes that were entirely disbelieving but also beyond horrified at the same time.

Seeing her reluctance or inability to reply, Kaiden decided to hammer the nail in more. "Like mother, like daughter. Is that what you want? To see your children sell themselves like you do? Well, if the answer is yes, then you’re doing a wonderful job at it."
This seemed to do the job of getting Julia out of her dazed state of mind. She started hyperventilating while tearing up and stammering, "N-no! No! I-I-I- this can’t be true!"

"But it is. If someone should know the truth, it would be me. After all, she sold her innocence to a porn studio. I was the one who tore her hymen. You can check online if you need concrete evidence."
Kaiden’s words immediately caused her tears to stop flowing as she growled at him with extreme fury. The woman then lunged at him while forming a fist, aiming for his jaw.

He watched the weak and frail woman’s actions without making a single move. Julia might as well have been moving in slow motion according to his perception, yet he still didn’t move to defend himself.
*Bam*

A mosquito bite’s equal force hit him before the woman lost her balance and fell. He reached out to grab her, which he did while facing very little opposition. She gasped with shock due to her ’attack’ having no effect, after which she started struggling to free herself, but Kaiden didn’t let her go. He could feel the sharpness of her bones pressing against his legs, and her futile thrashing made her seem even more fragile. Kaiden’s grip tightened, not out of malice but to keep her from spiraling further.

sentences.text: He stood behind a desk, so Kaiden thought he might be the receptionist.
"Morning," The man spat, letting Kaiden know hospitality was not a strong suit of this establishment.
"Morning.
I’m looking to speak with another receptionist working here."
"Another receptionist?" the man asked back with a tone that suggested Kaiden was speaking a foreign language.
"Yeah?" Kaiden was surprised.
Aria said her mother worked here as a receptionist.
If her colleague didn’t know her, then just what the hell was going on?
"Let’s clear this thing up.
You got a name?"
"Julia Levander."
The man smirked upon hearing his words.
"Thought so.
She was fired, or should I say demoted?" He then started chuckling ominously under his breath, letting his ugly, rotting teeth show.
Demoted?" Kaiden couldn’t help but feel that something was horribly wrong here.
"Just this morning, the boss had enough of her.
She’s one of the working girls now."
"I still wish to speak with her."
"Speak?"
"Yeah, I’m not interested in her services."
He shook his head and had an annoyed tone to his voice as if Kaiden was a pest he wanted to get rid of.
"No can do.
Pay for an hour or wait until her shift ends.
Though she might just pass out in her room after getting high, most of the workers do that."
"..." Kaiden was shocked at his attitude, while the words he spouted made his heart ache.
These people were utterly miserable.
"Alright, how much?"
"You’ll be her first customer, so there’s a big premium on her services... or so I would say, but that one is about to get past its expiry date, I’m afraid.
I would try to direct your attention to another whore but since you’re not here for that type of a visit I will not do so.
She costs $30 for an hour."
Kaiden couldn’t help but raise an eyebrow at her price.
This woman was selling her soul for such a meager amount?
She would make more as a waitress, and that was if she got to keep all of the money he paid for her time, which was entirely unrealistic.
She was working under the minimum wage and most likely by quite a bit at that.
"I see...
The ’receptionist’ then pushed a button, most likely to let her know a customer was coming up so she could make whatever last-minute preparations she needed to.
Kaiden then made his way up the stairs with a grim expression.
This place was just pure misery.
He knocked on the door as he was instructed to, and a faint "Come in" sounded from the other side.
He took a deep breath, preparing himself mentally, and then opened the door.
His heart instantly contorted to a horrible degree.
A woman stood in front of him who was very clearly Aria’s mother.
The resemblance was uncanny, but Kaiden felt like he was watching a ’bad end’ route to Aria’s story when he laid eyes on her mother.
Julia was all skin and bones, so much so that calling her anorexic would be generous.
Her long, silvery hair was ragged and started losing its unique color as it was turning grey instead.
Her exhausted eyes had big, dark circles under them, and there were no signs of life in them.
Back when the man down below called her an ’expiring product,’ Kaiden naively thought he meant she was getting on in age, but that was the least of her problems.
This was a dying woman.
Her frailty was so pronounced it was hard to imagine she had ever been a vibrant person, let alone someone who could have had children.
Her gaunt cheeks and hollowed eyes made her look more like a corpse than a mother.
"Is there an issue?
You can still request someone else..." Julia dejectedly murmured under her breath once he was staring at her for way too long.
Seeing he was reluctant to leave, she assumed he was here to stay, so the woman reached for her robe and began parting it alongside a heavy sigh.
Kaiden had two routes he could take.
The kind one or the harsh one.

As far as he was concerned, this was a mother who abandoned her children to pursue her drug addiction, so he went with the latter one, no matter how much it hurt him to see a ruined version of Aria be in even more pain than she already was.
Kaiden had to get to the bottom of things, and he thought this was the best path he could take.
To that end, he sat down in a chair nearby, making Julia eye him with confusion.
Kaiden followed up by speaking in a distant, authoritative tone.
"Stop disrobing yourself, I’m not here for pleasure.
I just wanted to see the failure of a mother who abandoned her three children."
Julia’s eyes immediately widened.
She took an instinctive step back, but then her spunk returned.
"I-I will not be spoken to like that!" she shouted and turned to leave, but then Kaiden raised his voice once again with an even more hostile tone.
"I bet you didn’t even know thatyouractions had forced Aria Levander to sell her virginity so that she could take care ofyourchildren, did you?"
Kaiden’s words made the miserable woman freeze in place for a good five seconds before she turned toward him with slow, robotic motions.
Julia mutely stared at him with eyes that were entirely disbelieving but also beyond horrified at the same time.
Seeing her reluctance or inability to reply, Kaiden decided to hammer the nail in more.
"Like mother, like daughter.
Is that what you want?
To see your children sell themselves like you do?
Well, if the answer is yes, then you’re doing a wonderful job at it."
This seemed to do the job of getting Julia out of her dazed state of mind.
She started hyperventilating while tearing up and stammering, "N-no!
No!
I-I-I- this can’t be true!"
"But it is.
If someone should know the truth, it would be me.
After all, she sold her innocence to a porn studio.
I was the one who tore her hymen.
You can check online if you need concrete evidence."
Kaiden’s words immediately caused her tears to stop flowing as she growled at him with extreme fury.
The woman then lunged at him while forming a fist, aiming for his jaw.
He watched the weak and frail woman’s actions without making a single move.
Julia might as well have been moving in slow motion according to his perception, yet he still didn’t move to defend himself.
*Bam*
A mosquito bite’s equal force hit him before the woman lost her balance and fell.
He reached out to grab her, which he did while facing very little opposition.
She gasped with shock due to her ’attack’ having no effect, after which she started struggling to free herself, but Kaiden didn’t let her go.
He could feel the sharpness of her bones pressing against his legs, and her futile thrashing made her seem even more fragile.
Kaiden’s grip tightened, not out of malice but to keep her from spiraling further.

chapters.title: Chapter 113: The Levanders’ Tragedy
paragraphs: During the little wrestling match of theirs, all Kaiden could think about was how lightweight this woman truly was. He already knew her to be anorexic, but now that she was in his arms, he felt the actual, sad reality.

Julia was about as tall as Aria, yet she weighed almost nothing in comparison. Aria was a healthy young woman who took good care of her body. She ate healthy food and developed good musculature through painstaking effort in the gym, so her weighing more than her mother was understandable, but it should never be to this degree.
"Let! Go!" she growled, but Kaiden didn’t relent.

Instead, he spoke back with a tone that was in line with his previous hostile attitude. "Why are you attacking me? Becauseyourdaughter was forced to do unspeakable things? In case you forgot, that only happened because both of her parents abandoned her without leaving an ounce of support behind for her, but what’s more disgusting is that they left her with two children to take care of. She worked night shifts in a bar and day shifts in a gym, but that wasn’t enough to take care ofyourkids, so she did what she had to do, for no one else would. How exactly am I at fault for anything?"
His accusatory, harsh words had a profound effect on the woman who, at long last, ceased her futile resistance and then began weeping uncontrollably.
Kaiden was not in a rush, so he let Julia cry her heart out.

It took ten minutes for her to calm down, at which point Kaiden spoke up once again, this time losing the hostile edge in his voice. "Aria is my beloved girlfriend, and I would do anything to make her happy. The reason I came here was to see if her mother was truly a hedonistic vile druggie akin to the image I had of her in my head. To see if she was beyond salvation or not. Hearing your extreme amount of grief, I can’t help but think that you care deeply for your children."
"O-of course I do! They are my everything!" Julia shouted defensively, but then her confused brain also understood his earlier words. "Wait, you’re in a relationship? But I thought..."
"That I’m a pornstar? I am, but we are what you would call amateurs. I film myself with my lovers exclusively."
"Lovers? What do you mean?" the mother asked with a loud gasp. She cleaned her moist eyes with her fingers, after which she looked up at him, expectantly waiting for his answer.

"There were two other similarly unfortunate girls at the filming. Things happened, and I’m the lucky man who can now call himself the lover of three precious existences," Kaiden explained things patiently.
"... I see... So... she is okay?"

"I can’t claim that she is as happy as she’d ever been since I’ve only known her for a month, but she is certainly very happy right now. Significantly happier than she was a month ago. Wait, I have a picture of her somewhere on my phone..." Kaiden fiddled around his apps until he found the selfie Aria had taken while he was princess carrying her. She was slyly looking at the camera while kissing him on the cheeks.

Julia reached for his phone with trembling hands. She studied the picture for a few seconds until her eyes teared up once again, but these were no tears of sorrow. She was so overjoyed her eyes were sparkling. "I-I can barely recognize her... She is just so happy!"

"That she is. Now, however, you’ve made me terribly confused. Why are you so caring of Aria when you cruelly abandoned her, with so much responsibility at that? She’s not even 20 years old yet, but because of her parents’ actions, she is basically single mothering two kids while also taking care of herself without even having higher education help her out with job opportunities."
His question made her wince, and her depressed state of being returned. "I have no words... I’m a complete failure of a mother."
Kaiden didn’t feel like letting her shut down in her self-blaming. "That’s just not true."

He then corrected, "I meant the former part of your statement, the one regarding you not having words. The latter is true—you did fuck up parenting pretty badly if I’m being honest. But you must have a story to tell, Julia. A mother who voluntarily leaves her children to their own devices doesn’t cry a river when she learns of their tragic fates."
"I said-"
She was cut off once again.

"None of us are saints. When my mother disowned me, I pretended to be all good and everything, but deep down, it hurt me. As a result, I refused to call her ’mother’ but by her real name, despite knowing full well that she loved me dearly and did what she did solely for my sake. I knew coldly calling her by her name would hurt her, so I did it as a form of my extremely petty revenge."

"I’m... sure there’s a lot to that story..." Julia muttered while trying to grasp his home situation. "But you’re right. There’s more to my story as well. However, if I say it, I fear it will come off as me justifying myself..."

"Stop your brooding. Unless you tell me what’s going on, you will be the greatest failure a mother could ever be in my eyes, so you can’t ruin your image any further as far as my opinion of you is concerned."

Kaiden’s statement made the woman whimper once again, but after a few seconds of silence, she nodded and told her story. "The man who calls himself my boyfriend and runs this establishment is a local gangster who eyed me for a long while. Back when my husband left me, I was at the lowest point of my life—or to be more correct, up until that point in my life—so I stupidly thought, why not give this guy a chance? What’s the worst that could happen? Maybe my life would be more exciting if I dated a gangster. That was the dumbest decision I could’ve ever made."

Julia spat her final sentence with fury, and after a short break where she collected her thoughts, she continued. "I quickly realized that this life was not what I wanted for myself or my children, at which point I broke up with him and planned to start working as many shifts as a waitress as was required so that we could escape the slums. He, however, took my breakup as a personal offense committed against his person, which was when I received my first beating. Our arguments quickly devolved, and things got worse, at which point he started threatening the safety of my children.

He gave me an ultimatum, which said that either I become his obedient lover or he would harm them. I know that the reasonable action on my part at that point would’ve been going to the police, but I didn’t dare put my children’s lives on the line. If I just did as I was told, they would be safe. Thus, I put my head down and obeyed."
"But why not just grab them and go to the police together? Say that your lives are in danger, you’ll receive protection," Kaiden argued.

chapters.title: Chapter 114: Andre
paragraphs: "Back when we were still living with the kids, he would always have some dumb muscle guys there as well. Their instructions were to kill my children if I made a run for it. Aria, Damian, and Lux are allowed to live in their lonesome without being watched because I moved out, and every single move of mine is carefully observed to ensure I don’t speak with them or the police without his knowledge."

"... Things are finally starting to become clear. So the relationship between you and the gangster kept worsening until just this morning he got fed up or bored with you, at which point he told you to make him some money with your body?" Kaiden asked.

"Yes..." Julia nodded with ashamed features. "I’m not a drug addict, I don’t gain any joy from snorting that horrible stuff. I’ve been pretending to be hooked on it so he thinks he has complete control over me. I once tried not taking it for a month straight when he wasn’t watching, and I had no problems. I even felt better about myself."
"I’m no doctor, but I think you need immediate medical attention, so it’s no wonder you felt better. It’s likely some cheap, horribly diluted product."
Julia simply nodded at his words.
Although Kaiden was happy he finally managed to get to the bottom of things, the overwhelming emotion swirling in his mind was not joy nor relief but a pure, unadulterated need to kill.
He wanted to end the life of another human being.

Ever since his awakening and forming his grandiose plans, Kaiden knew the day would come when he would have to shed human blood. He was a normal, 21st-century guy who didn’t think he would gain any semblance of joy from murder, but it simply needed to be done. Either he would kill his enemies, or he and all who he cared for would be killed.

Kaiden had no personal enemies besides that Maximilian bastard, but the CEO of ChronosX was entirely out of his reach for now. Other than him, he had no vendetta against others that would justify killing a human, but if Kaiden was being honest, he was hoping to gain one.
A personal, moral justification to end a fellow human’s life.
Kaiden felt he’d finally gained what he was looking for. "Tell me more about this man."

His words were cold and stated as if they were orders. Julia suddenly felt like she had no power to reject him, so she gulped nervously and began. "He is called Andre, a low-caliber gangster in the grand scheme of things, but he is one of the bigger fishes in the neighborhood. Please, I don’t like the terrifying look your eyes have! Tell me you don’t want to do something stupid!" her detailing quickly turned into pleading.

"I’ll kill him and free you of your shackles," Kaiden decreed, eliciting a pained cry from Julia. "Don’t! You’ll just ruin things! I kept obeying him for all this time, you’ll destroy all of my efforts!"
Kaiden merely eyed the woman without uttering another word—his cold gaze told her all she needed to know. Her opinion on the matter wasn’t asked.
Before she could muster another torrent of begging, they were interrupted. The door was kicked in, and two men walked in confidently.
Julia yelped from fright as she jumped out of Kaiden’s lap and asked, "What’s going on?!"
"You know you can’t have visitors, right? That dumbass forgot about the rule."
"He’s a paying customer!"
"Is he? You’ve been in the same room for dozens of minutes, yet all of your clothes are still on. He also told the receptionist he was here to have a chat with you, nothing else."

Julia turned toward Kaiden, who was still sitting on the sofa, oddly calm. She wordlessly asked for confirmation. He nodded. "Yeah, they’re right. I didn’t know you were a pitiful little bird in a cage, so I said something I shouldn’t have, it seems. Is Andre one of them?"

"N-no, but that doesn’t matter! You’re in big trouble, you have to make a run for it! I’ll plead with him to forgive you!" Julia shouted as she begged him to escape. Although she didn’t know much about him, their short interaction told the mother all she needed to know. He was a great man who took good care of her daughter.
"You’ll do no such thing..." Kaiden announced in a low, cold tone as he slowly rose to his feet. Both the enforcers and Julia felt confused as to why he was so calm.

Kaiden’s voice was low and controlled, but there was a weight to it that was hard to ignore. It wasn’t anger—no, it was something far more unsettling: a cold, calculating certainty that these men would soon regret crossing him.

Kaiden eyed the two men as he walked up to Julia and placed her behind his back. "You two are wielding weapons that were made with the main intention to aid in killing another human being. If you’re ready to kill, then you should be ready to put your life on the line..."
He tilted his head to the side as his eyes began gleaming menacingly. He only said two more words.
"Are you?"

As the words left Kaiden’s lips, his aura suddenly shifted from that of an eerily calm man to that of a bloodthirsty predator who presented a grave threat to their lives. The two men gulped involuntarily, and a chill was sent through their bodies. They shook for a moment.
But then, they remembered it was two against one and that they had weapons while he was unarmed. "Big words for a nobody! You watched one too many action movies, son!"
The other continued, "Come with us without making a fuss, and we’ll give you no trouble."

Kaiden sighed for a moment before the already gut-wrenching pressure he emitted toward the two was amplified tenfold. His dark eyes shifted in color, turning an ominous crimson red. He only uttered two words.
"Mode: Wrath."

He only uttered two words.
"Mode: Wrath."

chapters.title: Chapter 115: A Real Punch
paragraphs: Both men felt an instinctual dread wash over them. They took a step back in perfect sync—their survival instincts were screaming at them to run for their lives, but it was too late.
"This is how a real punch looks, Julia," Kaiden decreed before lunging at the left one. He aimed at the exact same spot where Julia had hit him previously, namely in the jaws.

While Julia didn’t even manage to make him feel an ounce of pain, the same couldn’t be said for the recipient of Kaiden’s strike. His fist shot forward like a cannonball, connecting with the man’s jaw.
*CRACK!*

A loud crack echoed through the room—the force of the blow sent the man’s head snapping to the side. His jaw dislocated instantly, and his teeth flew out like the shrapnel of a grenade, accompanied by a mouthful of blood that splattered across the walls.

The man let out a single cry of pure agony before collapsing to his knees, clutching at his ruined face. The sheer brutality of the strike had turned his lower jaw into an unrecognizable mass of flesh and bone that hung loosely. It barely managed to remain attached to his skull.
On the bright side, the man’s agony soon ceased.
He was breathing no longer.

"Eeeek!" the other enforcer allowed a rather girly cry to escape his lips. "A-a-awakened!!!" he shouted with utter shock while backing out of the room for a few seconds, after which his nerves could take it no longer—he turned on his heels and started running for his life.

Kaiden couldn’t let the man run away and notify the others, who could gear up in preparation for him. A single leap was enough to close the distance. His 17 Agility stat was already on the level of a top-tier athlete who specialized in a field that predominantly required speed to have a successful career in.

He put his arms around the man’s neck, holding him in a chokehold that didn’t allow him to scream for help. It didn’t take Kaiden more than a couple of seconds to win their struggle—his enemy’s head limply fell to the side.
Kaiden then grabbed onto his hair, dragging him back to the room so no one would find the corpse before he could make his next move.
He closed the door behind them. The room now housed Kaiden, two corpses, and a so shocked Julia she couldn’t help but gawk at him.
As Kaiden examined his brutal handiwork, he couldn’t help but sigh. "Shit... I don’t feel even an ounce of remorse.That womantruly is my mother; her cruel blood runs in my veins."
"W-w-what?!" Julia’s sudden shout took him out of his musings.
"Where’s this Andre fellow located at? I’ll finish the job."

"W-wait! I-I-" the mother’s panicked stuttering was silenced when Kaiden moved close to her and gave her a big warm hug. Once this poor woman was in his arms, and he could feel once again just how thin and fragile she was, his determination reached new heights.

They could most likely sneak out of the building and make a run for it, but he didn’t want to do that—not at all. He wanted to settle this affair with his own two hands, not call the police nor run for their lives. Kaiden tightened his embrace around Julia until she calmed down enough to give him the information he needed.
"At the top floor... That’s where his office is, but I think a few more men are there with him. They’re likely armed," she managed to relay the words to him with great concern.
"Alright. Stay here, or better yet, leave this place while I wreak havoc."
"No!" Julia shouted with more strength than she had intended to. "I want to see how this ends... Whether I’m freed or die alongside you... but please notify my daughter to escape in case we fall."
"Sure," Kaiden nodded and set a timed message that would be sent in fifteen minutes.

He then reached down for the two knives and left the room with a skittish Julia following him. This was quite likely the most nervous moment of her life, yet Kaiden felt eerily calm about it all. Well, beyond the extreme bloodlust he felt toward his enemy.
He would fight, and he would kill. That’s all that it was. There was no reason to overthink things.
They soon reached the door that should lead into Andre’s office.
Kaiden bluntly opened the door.

"Oh, is it done? Who was the-" a man’s voice spoke up, but the speaker froze before he could finish his question. It was not his two lackeys coming back but an unknown man with horribly scary red eyes. They shone with an entirely unnatural brightness.
"Get him!" the man seated at the desk shouted. Three men dashed at him.
Both of Kaiden’s hands were occupied with the knives he held, but that didn’t stop him from being able to aim his [Fiery Burst] at the men who charged at him.
Two men were hit and instantly became living torches who were screaming for their lives amidst the greatest agony they’d ever felt and ever would feel since they died almost immediately.

The last man who charged at him was speed-blitzed due to the great disparity between their Agility stats, which allowed Kaiden to easily deflect his strike and shove one of his blades deep into his chest. He followed it up by stabbing his prey with the other knife as well for good measure. Due to the great force behind his stabs, thanks to his Strength stat, the wounds were deep and lethal.
*Bang!*

The sound of a pistol shot sounded, and Kaiden felt incredible pain in his side. Andre wasn’t a stupid man who would begin his epic villain speech right now, evidenced by the fact that he followed up the initial shot with multiple other ones.

Kaiden gritted his teeth and then spat when blood began pouring from his mouth in concerning quantities. He wasn’t ready to just keel over and die, however—he grabbed his blade from the man’s chest and put every ounce of strength he had left into his next move: throwing the blade at Andre, knowing his life was on the line.

chapters.title: Chapter 116: Devouring Life
paragraphs: The dagger flew through the air as if it were in slow motion for all three observers. Julia was already tearing up from the many lethal wounds Kaiden suffered, while the man in question eyed his enemy with so much concentration one could think it was he who had telepathic powers, not Nyx. Andre, meanwhile, had his entire wretched life pass before his eyes. The knife landed in the man’s eye socket once it finished traversing its path.
"Shit!" Kaiden cursed as he fell to his knees. His strength was rapidly being depleted with every drop of blood he lost. He was shot at least four times.

"No, no, no, no!" Julia wept as she rushed up to him and tried her best to keep him from falling over. She was unsuccessful due to her severely weakened physical state. The mother fell to the floor together with Kaiden.
"Stop... crying... help me... get to... Andre..." Kaiden said with extremely pained gasps in between the mouthfuls of blood he had to spit.
"O-ok!" Although Julia was entirely lost, she felt she could trust this young man. Even while bleeding to his death at a rapid pace, he was giving off the vibes of a man who was in control.

She exerted every ounce of power she could to help him crawl to Andre. "Is he... alive?" Kaiden’s strange question made Julia listen to the man’s ragged breathing. "Yes! But barely... I don’t think he has long left!"

"Cut... arm cloth... use... knife... Mode: Gluttony..." Kaiden’s next set of instructions came with even more difficulty as he started choking on his own blood. His bright red eyes shifted in color to orange.
The color of consumption in excess which perfectly conveyed a burning, insatiable appetite that devoured all in its path.

Julia diligently did as told. She almost pulled the knife from Andre’s eyes, but she managed to catch herself. The man, whose name she didn’t even know, wanted Andre alive. Pulling it out would only make him succumb to death faster, so she ran to the man Kaiden had killed earlier and pulled the blade from his chest with much difficulty.
It was a sharp knife; cutting Andre’s clothes on his arm was easy. The dying man was seated on his chair, and Kaiden could only crawl at best, so he reached up for his arm and pulled it down.
"[Ravenous Bite]," he cast his spell.
Kaiden’s teeth elongated into razor-sharp fangs that were perfect for blood extraction, while his orange eyes started glowing brighter, pulsating with the rhythm of his ragged breaths.

Kaiden sank his fangs into Andre’s arm, piercing through flesh and veins like a starving predator feasting on its prey. Warm blood flowed into his mouth in a torrent. Its metallic taste sent a wave of primal satisfaction through him. This was no ordinary bite—his [Ravenous Bite] devoured more than blood. It siphoned life force itself, pulling vitality from the trembling man into Kaiden’s damaged body.

Andre’s weakened gasps turned into desperate, gurgling screams as he felt his very essence being drained. His arm quivered uncontrollably while his body jerked in agony. The veins around the bite darkened before they began spreading farther as though corruption itself was consuming his body from within.

Kaiden could feel the searing pain in his abdomen where the bullets had torn through flesh and muscle begin to dull. The warmth of life coursed into his veins, knitting together wounds that moments ago were fatal. His breathing steadied, his heart pumped with faster and stronger beats, and his blurred vision sharpened once more. In a supernatural turn of events, even the bullets were pushed outside of the flesh they were lodged in.
Andre’s struggle weakened with every passing second. His screams faded into a faint whimper before ceasing entirely, after which his head slumped. He never moved.
By the time Kaiden released his hold and pulled away, Andre’s arm was a grotesque black thing.

Kaiden let out a deep sigh of relief before wiping his bloody lips on Andre’s clothes. His wounds had stabilized, his breathing was no longer labored, and while he wasn’t at full strength, he felt much better. Kaiden was still wounded, but the critical bleeding had stopped, and his body wasn’t trying to shut down any longer.

"Are-are you okay?!" Julia asked with great concern. She had long since given up on trying to understand the situation, she just wanted her daughter’s partner to survive. If her daughter received even more grief than she already did because of her, Julia didn’t know what she would do.
"He died before I could finish draining him... I’m not going to die, but it still hurts like a bitch."
"Then you should take my blood!" Julia offered as she parted her robes on her shoulders, but she was stopped.
"You would die if I took a single drop. Instead, tell me, is there a customer who is as bad as these people? I would rather not prey on innocents."
Julia started thinking, but before she could reply, another voice sounded. "No need. Take from me."
"I can also do it! It’s like a romantic vampire movie!"
"Did he really kill Andre?!"
Numerous voices sounded as the prostitutes stormed into the room.’Ah, the gunshots... the shouting probably didn’t help either...’Kaiden realized their fight had ended up being rather loud.

He selected one of the plumper ones who offered her blood to him. When Kaiden drained Andre of his life, he allowed his insatiable hunger to overtake his mind, but this time around, he remained in control of his feelings. As a result, he could take in measured sips instead of all-consuming excess. There was no corruption of the body, no dark veins. She remained fine throughout the event and even seemed to be enjoying it, though that might’ve been because of a romantic vampire movie she saw.
Kaiden noticed that this gentle method was a lot slower in replenishing his health than when he forcefully drained Andre of all his life force.
Just as he finished healing himself, a shout sounded. "Police! Freeze!"

chapters.title: Chapter 117: Police Interrogation
paragraphs: An entire task force entered the room, with riot shields, assault rifles, shotguns, and all the good stuff.

"Don’t say anything! I’ll solve everything! If you’re questioned, demand a lawyer! Never speak with the police without an attorney present!" Kaiden shouted his instructions so all the women could hear him perfectly well, which earned him threatening growls from multiple police officers.
They allowed themselves to be placed in handcuffs—well, only Kaiden did; the others couldn’t fight back even if they wanted to. They were quickly escorted to the police station.
Thankfully, Kaiden had at least enough time to cancel his timed message to Aria. The girls were likely in the middle of their gym session, he didn’t want to scare them needlessly.

"My name is Detective Montgomery, the lead detective of your case," a man grunted as he sat down in front of Kaiden in the isolated interrogation room he was dragged to. "To start, let me read you your rights."
"No need to," Kaiden said nonchalantly.
"I’m afraid I must do so. My hands are tied by the words written in the hefty book I rested my hand on while I swore my oath," the officer replied.
"I want to have a phone call with someone."
"With whom?"
"My mother."
"..." The detective hesitated for a second. Kaiden was not technically under arrest yet, so Montgomery wasn’t obligated to let him make a call.
"If I can’t have my call, then I’ll ask for a lawyer."

Kaiden’s declaration made Montgomery curse inwardly. He didn’t understand why this cold-blooded murderer would want to have a phone call with someone who was not his lawyer. Did he seriously want to have a final call with Mommy before getting officially charged with multiple first-degree murders?

However, if the young man called for a lawyer, then this questioning would end immediately, so letting him make a phone call was the better option. Maybe hearing his mommy’s sweet voice would make him want to confess without trouble. Many such cases happened during his long career.
"Sure, lad. Whatever makes you comfortable. Here, use mine," he nodded and handed his cell phone over. "But you’ll have to put it on speaker mode."
Kaiden grabbed it and dialed his mother’s secret private number that only a few people had the privilege of knowing.
"Yes?" Vespera Ashborn picked up immediately.
"It’s me. I need your help."
"Why?"
"I killed some people."
"Why?"
"They were the kind of people who forced women to get addicted to drugs and sell themselves for mere pittances."
"I’ll take care of it."
"Make sure you help the women as well. They were detained alongside me."

Vespera put the phone down as an answer to his last comment. Montgomery looked at him with wide, shocked eyes. Did he just confess to his crimes in an interrogation room where his conversation was being recorded? In front of the lead detective of his case?!

However, he was a professional, so he managed to gather his bearings. He needed to gather as much information from the suspect as possible to make his conviction a homerun victory in court—though it already was a done-and-dusted case, as far as he was concerned.
"May I read your rights now?" he asked and received a disinterested shrug. "Sure thing, man."
A vein bulged on the detective’s forehead due to this young man’s uncaring attitude, but he completed reading his rights. It was time to ask his questions.
"Let’s backpedal a bit, shall we? Tell me what you were doing yesterday."
"I cooked an amazing meal and then had a lengthy foursome with my harem of extreme beauties."

Hearing such obvious lies infuriated the detective. "Listen, lad, this is no joking matter! Multiple people lie dead in their own pool of blood! Do you have an idea how much trouble you’re in? If you show the right attitude, the judge might treat you with more consideration for your young age. You might not have to die in prison, spending your elder years as a free man." Montgomery wanted to take a friendly attitude with this criminal, but that was evidently not going to work, so he quickly switched gears.

Kaiden nonchalantly leaned back in his chair despite the detective’s heavy threats, and when the phone started ringing, a knowing smirk erupted on his features. "I think you should pick your phone up, detective."
Montgomery cursed annoyedly for being interrupted during interrogation, but he started frowning when he saw a government number. He didn’t recognize it.
He hastily picked it up. "Yes? Detective Sergeant Montgomery speaking."
His features immediately paled once the caller introduced himself. He couldn’t help but stammer out in disbelief, "C-C-Chief of Staff?!"
The Chief of Staff was the president’s right-hand man, making it arguably the second most influential position in the governing body of the United States of America.
Montgomery was a mid-level detective, he had never conversed with such an important man before. Hell, he hadn’t even laid his eyes on one throughout his entire life!

His shock only grew to new heights when the Chief of Staff started shouting at him with so much strength in his voice that even Kaiden could hear his words clearly. "Let the man you’re interrogating walk! Any other arrests you made as well! The deaths resulted from a police raid on a cartel or something, I don’t care!"
The urgency in the caller’s tone made it seem as if the fate of the country depended on the detective following his orders down to the letter.
"B-b-but sir! It’s a done-and-dusted case! I could charge him right now and-"

"SILENCE!" The Chief of Staff started screaming from the top of his lungs. "I don’t need to explain myself to you, detective! Let them go and make sure there’s no trail of them left in the system as well! If you don’t do as told, I’ll have you arrested for domestic terrorism!"

"D-domestic t-t-t-terrosim?!" Montgomery cried with utter disbelief. He was a loyal police officer who served this country for three decades with a spotless track record, and now his freedom was threatened? For what? Arresting a mass murderer? However, the detective knew when he needed to bow his head and back off. No one wanted a dog who barked too much.
"Yes, sir. Understood."
"Boyfriend!" Julia shouted as she rushed at Kaiden to hug him.
"Hey, people will get the wrong idea," he replied with amusement but didn’t reject her embrace.
"But I don’t even know what your name is!"
"Kaiden."
"Kaiden, nice to meet you!" she cheered while strengthening her grip around him.
"Yes, nice to meet you!" the other ladies who stood around watching the spectacle unfold also greeted him.
"Thanks for killing the bastard." Many offered him their gratitude in a similar fashion.
"Don’t worry about it. He got what he deserved."

"You must have friends in very high places! I’ve never seen such an obvious murder case get thrown out this swiftly," another said with sparkling eyes full of amazement. "This is the kind of thing that only happens in movies or fairy tales! I can’t believe how fast everything went down!"
Right?! My heart is still throbbing violently in my chest!"
