"Sure, lad.
Whatever makes you comfortable.
Here, use mine," he nodded and handed his cell phone over.
"But you’ll have to put it on speaker mode."
Kaiden grabbed it and dialed his mother’s secret private number that only a few people had the privilege of knowing.
"Yes?" Vespera Ashborn picked up immediately.
"It’s me.
I need your help."
"Why?"
"I killed some people."
"Why?"
"They were the kind of people who forced women to get addicted to drugs and sell themselves for mere pittances."
"I’ll take care of it."
"Make sure you help the women as well.
They were detained alongside me."
Vespera put the phone down as an answer to his last comment.
Montgomery looked at him with wide, shocked eyes.
Did he just confess to his crimes in an interrogation room where his conversation was being recorded?
In front of the lead detective of his case?!
However, he was a professional, so he managed to gather his bearings.
He needed to gather as much information from the suspect as possible to make his conviction a homerun victory in court—though it already was a done-and-dusted case, as far as he was concerned.
"May I read your rights now?" he asked and received a disinterested shrug.
"Sure thing, man."
A vein bulged on the detective’s forehead due to this young man’s uncaring attitude, but he completed reading his rights.
It was time to ask his questions.
"Let’s backpedal a bit, shall we?
Tell me what you were doing yesterday."
"I cooked an amazing meal and then had a lengthy foursome with my harem of extreme beauties."
Hearing such obvious lies infuriated the detective.
"Listen, lad, this is no joking matter!
Multiple people lie dead in their own pool of blood!
Do you have an idea how much trouble you’re in?
If you show the right attitude, the judge might treat you with more consideration for your young age.

You might not have to die in prison, spending your elder years as a free man." Montgomery wanted to take a friendly attitude with this criminal, but that was evidently not going to work, so he quickly switched gears.
Kaiden nonchalantly leaned back in his chair despite the detective’s heavy threats, and when the phone started ringing, a knowing smirk erupted on his features.
"I think you should pick your phone up, detective."
Montgomery cursed annoyedly for being interrupted during interrogation, but he started frowning when he saw a government number.
He didn’t recognize it.
He hastily picked it up.
"Yes?
Detective Sergeant Montgomery speaking."
His features immediately paled once the caller introduced himself.
He couldn’t help but stammer out in disbelief, "C-C-Chief of Staff?!"
The Chief of Staff was the president’s right-hand man, making it arguably the second most influential position in the governing body of the United States of America.
Montgomery was a mid-level detective, he had never conversed with such an important man before.
Hell, he hadn’t even laid his eyes on one throughout his entire life!
His shock only grew to new heights when the Chief of Staff started shouting at him with so much strength in his voice that even Kaiden could hear his words clearly.
"Let the man you’re interrogating walk!
Any other arrests you made as well!
The deaths resulted from a police raid on a cartel or something, I don’t care!"
The urgency in the caller’s tone made it seem as if the fate of the country depended on the detective following his orders down to the letter.
"B-b-but sir!
It’s a done-and-dusted case!
I could charge him right now and-"
"SILENCE!" The Chief of Staff started screaming from the top of his lungs.
"I don’t need to explain myself to you, detective!
Let them go and make sure there’s no trail of them left in the system as well!
If you don’t do as told, I’ll have you arrested for domestic terrorism!"
"D-domestic t-t-t-terrosim?!" Montgomery cried with utter disbelief.
He was a loyal police officer who served this country for three decades with a spotless track record, and now his freedom was threatened?
For what?
Arresting a mass murderer?
However, the detective knew when he needed to bow his head and back off.
No one wanted a dog who barked too much.
"Yes, sir.
Understood."
"Boyfriend!" Julia shouted as she rushed at Kaiden to hug him.
"Hey, people will get the wrong idea," he replied with amusement but didn’t reject her embrace.
"But I don’t even know what your name is!"
"Kaiden."
"Kaiden, nice to meet you!" she cheered while strengthening her grip around him.
"Yes, nice to meet you!" the other ladies who stood around watching the spectacle unfold also greeted him.
"Thanks for killing the bastard." Many offered him their gratitude in a similar fashion.
"Don’t worry about it.
He got what he deserved."
"You must have friends in very high places!
I’ve never seen such an obvious murder case get thrown out this swiftly," another said with sparkling eyes full of amazement.
"This is the kind of thing that only happens in movies or fairy tales!
I can’t believe how fast everything went down!"
Right?!
My heart is still throbbing violently in my chest!"

chapters.title: Chapter 118: Reunion of Mother and Daughter
paragraphs: "Well, I’m glad you ladies had some fun," Kaiden chuckled but didn’t explain himself any further about the ’contact in high places.’
Instead, he added, "It’s about time Julia and I leave. Are you going to be fine?"
"Yes!" A chorus of positive replies welcomed his question.

"Alright, if any trouble arises, you can contact me through the awakened platform if you search for Valhalla’s Sinners. Remember, nothing happened today. No words to anyone. Trust me when I say this: you don’t want to make the person who helped us out today into your enemy."
"Yes!"
They soon separated. He helped the weak Julia into the taxi he called, which stopped at the gym where Aria should be just about finishing today’s training.
The duo waited in front of the gym for the girls to come out. While doing so, Julia started trembling due to nervousness. "What if she hates me?"
"She doesn’t."
"But what if she does?!"
"Then you get on your knees and apologize, or whatever it takes to earn her forgiveness."
"But what if that doesn’t work either?!" she cried hysterically.

"Woman, keep it together. If it doesn’t work, then you keep begging, pleading, doing whatever else it takes. And if she absolutely refuses to forgive you, then you pack your bag and move out of her life."
"... Yeah... I owe Aria this," Julia said while squeezing Kaiden’s hand, which she was holding all this time.
"Kai? M-mom?" Aria gasped when the three of them came out of the gym at long last.
Kaiden only smiled. He didn’t want to speak up, it was not his moment.
"I-I’m so s-sorry!" Julia shouted while kneeling in front of her daughter, with great sorrow and regret being evident in her shaky tone.

"Mom, what are you doing?! Get up, people are watching!" Aria tried to raise her mother from her kowtowing position, but despite Julia’s horribly weakened physical state, the girl seemed to struggle. The mother was adamant about staying glued to the cold ground.
"I don’t care! I’m begging for my daughter’s forgiveness, I couldn’t care less what strangers think of me!"
"I-I don’t really get it, I’m not angry with you for anything! But sure, I forgive you!" Aria decreed with great confusion.

Kaiden couldn’t help but have his smile turn up a notch.’I thought so. She didn’t harbor any resentment in her beautiful heart despite what she went through because of Julia. She’s a literal angel...’he exclaimed inwardly as he eyed Aria, who finally managed to forcefully lift her mother off the pavement and hug her.

"Ladies, let’s go home. Aria should spend some alone time with her mother," Kaiden said to his two confused lovers, who were dragging themselves with extremely exhausted bodies. Aria must’ve put them through the wringer quite badly.
"Sure..." Luna moaned painedly. Nyx was too tired to respond; she just nodded.
"I’m happy for you," Luna stated while gently patting Aria’s shoulder as she walked by her toward Kaiden. "Yeah... Enjoy..." Nyx added, with so little energy one could mistake her for a zombie.

"I don’t know what you did, but thanks, Kai!" Aria shouted at her boyfriend with eyes full of overflowing love. The mother who was distant toward her all this while was now crying her heart out in her arms.
Did he truly solve her problems within a few hours? She didn’t know how he did it, but her man was most certainly the absolute best!
"Carry," Luna demanded while raising her arms toward him expectantly, as if she were his baby.
Kaiden chuckled amusedly for but a second before reaching behind her thighs and easily lifting her into his arms.
"Ah! Not fair!" Life returned to Nyx’s features as she cried ’injustice!’ with all her being.

"Come," Kaiden gestured with his free hand after seating Luna in only one of his arms. He had enough strength to easily carry two of his lovers, which was exactly what he did when he lifted her into his other arm.

"Kya! My boyfriend is amazing! Ahahaha! That’s right, stare at me jealously, bitches! Your men are all betas in comparison!" Julia and her desperate begging had drawn quite the crowd already, so now, many eyes were attached to Kaiden and the two otherworldly beauties in his arms.

Nyx saw the gazes on them and couldn’t help but boast about her amazing boyfriend as he carried his tired princesses off into the sunset in his arms. Many ladies started eyeing her with gazes that were a mixture of disbelief at her shamelessness and jealousy at her relationship, which seemed to be standing on the most stable of foundations—meaning they were madly in love. Men, on the other hand, sent cold glares at her and also at Kaiden, but neither of them could give a single ounce of care for what the observers thought.
That’s right; when it came to utter shamelessness, the person who could match Nyx Cosmos the best was none other than the man called Kaiden Grey.
"Did anyone recognize you in the gym?" Kaiden asked as the crowd parted to let them pass. He went toward where the taxies were stationed.
"Hehe! We’re not that famous yet!" Nyx replied merrily.
"I’m having my first cheat day," Luna announced matter of factly.
"Sis, this was your first day in the gym! You can’t start cheating already!" The girl sitting opposite of her protested.
"First of all, I’m not your sister. Second, either I’m getting my pancakes or I’m biting someone."
"Oh, living up to your chaos gremlin epithet, I see!"
"You’re lucky I’m too tired to beat you up..." Luna growled.
"I’m down to fight at any time!"
Their bickering continued all the way until they reached their home. Even in the taxi, they refused to let go of him, so Kaiden was forced to sit in the back, between the pair of fierce kittens.
"Kaiden!!!" Lux cheered while rushing right into his arms. "Thank you so much!"

It was the next day, and Kaiden came to visit the Levander family in the hospital. Julia spent the night in intensive care, but by noon, she was no longer in danger of death, so she was allowed to enter the general ward. It would take a few more days for her to be discharged if all went well.

Damian was evidently not as ready to offer his forgiveness to his mother as his sisters were because he refused to come here. He seemed to be a youngster who was simply too angry with the world, and Kaiden could understand him perfectly. It was not him who was a bitter kid, but it was rather that Aria and Lux were too big-hearted, he thought.
"You don’t have to thank me for anything," he replied while stroking Lux’s lush silver hair.
"But I do! You saved my mother!"
"Well, alright..." he chuckled before adding, "You’re welcome."
Kaiden then turned toward Aria. "I spoke with Anna, there’s an apartment with four bedrooms next to ours. We should move there while Julia and your siblings move into ours."
"No!" Aria shouted strongly, surprising Kaiden greatly. However, her next words cleared his confusion up. "I can’t moan to my heart’s content if my family lives next door!"
Kaiden burst into laughter at his awesome girl’s antics, but then, a sudden [Ding!] sounded in his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 119: Immense Luck!
paragraphs: Kaiden was still in the middle of hugging the overly excited and happy Lux when a notification sounded in his head.
[Ding!]
[Main Mission: ’Moon Valkyrie’s Troubles’ completed!]
[Rewards]
1: Random Skill Card
2: Upgrade Point
With this, he was back to 4 Upgrade Points, which was the amount he had before spending one on his [First-Person Camera], upgrading it to [Harem Vision].
Kaiden had a bit of an issue: he was an unapologetic hoarder. He wanted to hoard the points until he got a skill he was sure needed to be upgraded.
Thus, it was time to open the Random Skill Card.

The same tense gacha-style opening ceremony started in his mind; however, by the end, the trumpets were singing victoriously as if he was an emperor returning from a great war that’d just been won. Even cheering sounds were added...’This Heavenly Demon dude has a taste for theatrics, that’s for sure...’Kaiden snickered inwardly, but he couldn’t help but feel great anticipation.
It seemed that he—at long last—high-rolled the skill opening.
The card stopped spinning. It featured an art of a man who had his lips closed and an X was overlaid his mouth.

[The Heavenly Demon once said, "Screw you and screw your stupid laws, Universe! I’m the man who is destined to stand above all, you have no hope of containing me!" after which he spent 5,000 years developing a technique that allowed him to ignore one of the universe’s most fundamental laws: to cast spells, one must formulate them into clear words, or to the best of their current ability. The Successor inherited the fruits of the Heavenly Demon’s arduous labor.]
[???-tier skill, ’Silent Casting’ unlocked!]
[Silent Casting: Cast spells without uttering a single word.]
"Heavenly Demon, I fucking love you..." Kaiden muttered out loud, eliciting a gasp from Lux. "Bad words can’t be said in Aria’s presence, or she will scold you!"
"Kaiden gets a pass..." Aria giggled, receiving a "not fair!" shout of protest in response.

Kaiden was shocked. He already knew this Heavenly Demon guy was an incredibly strong person, but to think he could circumvent such a universal law. Also, 5,000 years? His benefactor’s scale of existence was beyond his comprehension. He spent 200 times Kaiden’s entire lifespan’s worth of time just to solve this single issue...?

Furthermore...’This Universe thing again, huh? The Heavenly Demon hated being restricted by its imposed rules, so he rebelled against the universe itself. That might’ve been what led to his downfall.’These were the conclusions he could draw from his currently available information, but it was mostly just his headcanon, nothing factual.

"Thank you, Kaiden. Truly," Julia spoke up all of a sudden. She’d been watching the ongoings from her hospital bed with keen eyes. It was very easy for her to understand that not only was the selfie he showed her back when they met telling the truth but that he was also a good big brother figure, evidenced by Lux’s refusal to let go of him as if she were a little monkey baby clinging to her mother. She thought it would not be an exaggeration on her part to exclaim that he was the savior of her family.
But saving was not all he did.
He elevated them.

They were now a family who could proudly proclaim that they had an awakened in their midst! Her beloved daughter was a superhuman! The future of the Levander family was brighter than ever, and it was all thanks to this young man.

She’d also learned from her daughter that the mysterious helper of theirs was none other than the global phenomenon called Vespera Ashborn. Julia nearly suffered a heart attack when she learned that fact, but after calming down, she couldn’t help but wonder if her future included having amicable chats with the Shadow Monarch as two mothers-in-law. That thought was both thrilling and terrifying at the same time, making her skin crawl.
Even she saw clips of the woman, and let’s just say that she was the bigger, meaner, and significantly more menacing version of the red-eyed monstrous Kaiden who killed her oppressors in cold blood.
"I’m getting too many words of gratitude recently..." Kaiden whined, eliciting a round of merry giggling from the Levanders.
Next, Kaiden gave Montgomery a call, asking the man to solve Julia’s loss of custody over her children.
He only received some annoyed grumbling in response, something about this not being detailed in his job description, but the issue was solved very swiftly.

Kaiden despised having to rely on Vespera after he decided he would stand on his two legs. Not necessarily because he didn’t want to rely on his mother, but more so because it told him he was just a small fish in the grand scale of things.

Yes, he’d managed to single-handedly eliminate a little gang of non-awakened humans, but even then, he had almost died while doing so, and if not for his connections, he would’ve been thrown into jail.

There were high tensions in society about the awakened oppressing the commoners, so the government was on edge. They felt the need to be very strict on the awakened because if they looked away in cases of awakened humans abusing their superiority to bully the non-awakened, widespread riots could happen.

Despite the arrival of the mana apocalypse, the USA was still greatly resembling its previous self, at least as far as its governing body went. Only about 15% of the populace awakened as superhumans, so 85% were normal people. If those 85% got fed up, they could cause great damage to the government.
Furthermore, a lot of politicians were non-awakened, so they felt a very strong need to not allow awakened people to get ideas about changes in leadership and the like.

Naturally, many awakened hated the current status quo as they felt they deserved special treatment due to them being akin to supreme existences who’d risen above humanity. As such, a careful balancing act was required from the government to retain peace and prosperity.

Kaiden knew he had to quickly secure a strong position for himself where he wasn’t just a throwaway pawn on the government’s chess board in cases like what had happened yesterday. He couldn’t keep relying on Vespera coming in and saving his ass every time he got in trouble.

He was not even an Ashborn anymore. Every time he called for her help, they risked their real relationship being found out. Kaiden knew that Vespera would help him even if there was a 100% chance of their secret being found out by the whole world, but if that happened, his life would become very difficult as well.

Vespera had so many enemies that counting them would be mission impossible. Almost all foreign powers would benefit from her downfall, and numerous domestic ones as well. If people learned her son was running around in his lonesome without protection, he would become a weak link that could be used to defeat Vespera, thus, he and his girls would have to go into hiding unless they became top-tier combatants who could protect themselves before the secret got out.

An additional problem would be the reaction of the other Ashborn family members. His father, two brothers, and elder sister would hate him for ruining their prestigious name by becoming a pornstar, thus Kaiden and co’s lives would be in danger even if they decided to hide themselves.
To sum it all up, he had to become a man who could protect all he cared about with his own two hands.
To that end... "Aria, how about we go for our second dungeon dive? I was thinking we could go deeper into the forest," he asked his gorgeous silver-haired lover.
"I’m in, Kai!" she chirped cheerily; however, suddenly, her features turned dark as she started glaring at him menacingly, doing an instant 180.

"Before that,dearest boyfriend, could you explain to your loving girlfriend why you decided to invade a criminal organization on your own while you sent the three of us to have fun in the freaking gym?! You should’ve called for assistance!" Her voice grew sharper, her piercing gaze unwavering, making it clear she wasn’t about to let this slip by. A threatening vein bulged on her forehead as she crossed her arms in front of her delicate chest and impatiently tapped her finger against her arm.

Next, Kaiden gave Montgomery a call, asking the man to solve Julia’s loss of custody over her children.
He only received some annoyed grumbling in response, something about this not being detailed in his job description, but the issue was solved very swiftly.
Kaiden despised having to rely on Vespera after he decided he would stand on his two legs.
Not necessarily because he didn’t want to rely on his mother, but more so because it told him he was just a small fish in the grand scale of things.

Yes, he’d managed to single-handedly eliminate a little gang of non-awakened humans, but even then, he had almost died while doing so, and if not for his connections, he would’ve been thrown into jail.
There were high tensions in society about the awakened oppressing the commoners, so the government was on edge.
They felt the need to be very strict on the awakened because if they looked away in cases of awakened humans abusing their superiority to bully the non-awakened, widespread riots could happen.
Despite the arrival of the mana apocalypse, the USA was still greatly resembling its previous self, at least as far as its governing body went.
Only about 15% of the populace awakened as superhumans, so 85% were normal people.
If those 85% got fed up, they could cause great damage to the government.
Furthermore, a lot of politicians were non-awakened, so they felt a very strong need to not allow awakened people to get ideas about changes in leadership and the like.
Naturally, many awakened hated the current status quo as they felt they deserved special treatment due to them being akin to supreme existences who’d risen above humanity.
As such, a careful balancing act was required from the government to retain peace and prosperity.
Kaiden knew he had to quickly secure a strong position for himself where he wasn’t just a throwaway pawn on the government’s chess board in cases like what had happened yesterday.
He couldn’t keep relying on Vespera coming in and saving his ass every time he got in trouble.
He was not even an Ashborn anymore.
Every time he called for her help, they risked their real relationship being found out.
Kaiden knew that Vespera would help him even if there was a 100% chance of their secret being found out by the whole world, but if that happened, his life would become very difficult as well.
Vespera had so many enemies that counting them would be mission impossible.
Almost all foreign powers would benefit from her downfall, and numerous domestic ones as well.

If people learned her son was running around in his lonesome without protection, he would become a weak link that could be used to defeat Vespera, thus, he and his girls would have to go into hiding unless they became top-tier combatants who could protect themselves before the secret got out.
An additional problem would be the reaction of the other Ashborn family members.

His father, two brothers, and elder sister would hate him for ruining their prestigious name by becoming a pornstar, thus Kaiden and co’s lives would be in danger even if they decided to hide themselves.
To sum it all up, he had to become a man who could protect all he cared about with his own two hands.
To that end...
"Aria, how about we go for our second dungeon dive?
I was thinking we could go deeper into the forest," he asked his gorgeous silver-haired lover.
"I’m in, Kai!" she chirped cheerily; however, suddenly, her features turned dark as she started glaring at him menacingly, doing an instant 180.

"Before that,dearest boyfriend, could you explain to your loving girlfriend why you decided to invade a criminal organization on your own while you sent the three of us to have fun in the freaking gym?!
You should’ve called for assistance!" Her voice grew sharper, her piercing gaze unwavering, making it clear she wasn’t about to let this slip by.
A threatening vein bulged on her forehead as she crossed her arms in front of her delicate chest and impatiently tapped her finger against her arm.

chapters.title: Chapter 120: Family Drama
paragraphs: Kaiden flinched, knowing he had messed up greatly. It would’ve been one thing if the foul-mouthed Luna or the very emotionally expressive Nyx was this furious with him for what he’d done, but if this extremely serene creature who was the human embodiment of the moon was so angry, then he truly made a big blunder.
He glanced at Julia, who failed to meet his eyes. "S-sorry..." she whispered in a low tone.
Kaiden sighed. "It’s fine. I shouldn’t keep things from my girls."
"That’s right!" Aria hissed.
He gently detached himself from Lux, who started watching the unfolding drama with glittering eyes and an entirely amused expression. As a teen, the young girl lived for these dramatic moments.
Kaiden then went to Aria and reached his arms out to envelop the woman in a hug.

To his utmost horror, his Moon Valkyrie refused the gesture by swatting his hands away in annoyance. "No, Kaiden, this time around, you don’t get to hug me, kiss the top of my head, and whisper sweet words into my ears to make up. I know that I seem like a soft woman, but let it be known that Aria Levander can put her foot down when the situation calls for it!"
*Stomp!* She stomped on the ground to further communicate her current stance.

While it was true he didn’t know that the situation with Julia would end up devolving into a battle when he said his goodbyes to his three lovers and went to check on the mother, but it was also true that he had more than enough chances to escape and call for backup after he killed the two grunts who kicked the door down.
Kaiden merely chose not to—he wanted to settle things with his own hands.
He lowered his hands and began explaining his thoughts with a pained expression, "I didn’t call you because I feared for your safety-"

Aria wasn’t having it. "So? Do you think yourself to be bulletproof, Kaiden Grey? Don’t delude yourself. Your life was at an incredible risk. I’m forever grateful for what you’ve done for me and my family, but that doesn’t mean I can’t be angry if you do something reckless—no, something outright stupid like this."

Seeing the extreme amount of worry and hurt in her eyes, Kaiden couldn’t help but have his heart contort painedly. Aria clearly felt like he didn’t trust her when push came to shove, and he couldn’t help but realize that she was exactly right. He believed them to not be ready for what had to be done.
"I’m sorry, Aria. I couldn’t bear imagining any of you dying on me."

Aria’s harsh features decreased in intensity when she saw he understood her, however, that didn’t mean she was finished. "They say the biggest victims of war are not the fallen soldiers but the mothers and wives who have to bury the remains of their sons and husbands. I now fully understand why such a saying came into existence. Do you think losing you would be easier for us than the other way around? That we love you less than you love us? That we are women who evolved to have the notion of grief ingrained in our existences so we can deal with it easier than men? ... Or are you just a hedonist who doesn’t want to deal with loss?"
Aria’s accusations pained Kaiden, but what truly made him feel horrible were the heavy tears forming in her eyes.

"We might not be very strong right now, but we’re not just your girlfriends, Kaiden. We agreed to become your Valkyries so that we could stand by your side through thick and thin. We want to be there for you when you face grave peril, not just when everything is sailing smoothly. If you just want girlfriends to have fun cooking and easy dungeon streams with, then I-"
Kaiden didn’t let her finish her sentence. In the next moment, he pulled the sobbing woman in for a hug.

Now, he fully understood the amount of pain he’d caused. Kaiden knew his decision was logical. Even if he didn’t consider their current weak state of being, the girls were not mentally ready to kill humans.
However, that didn’t excuse his actions. He asked these precious existences to accompany him through his supernatural journey.
They were not eye candies he could have fun with when he felt like it.
They were his Sinsworn Valkyries, his greatest allies.

In a way, he betrayed them. It was fine for him to tackle the final boss in a dungeon if he was stronger than them. It was fine for him to ask them to deal with the small fry while he did so. It was also fine for him to tell them to step aside if he felt he was enough to deal with an enemy.

However, it was not okay for Kaiden to ask them to stay at home while he went and risked his life. That was not how the relationship between the Paragon of Sin and his Sinsworn Valkyries was meant to function. As soon as they became his Valkyries, they ceased being damsels in distress, transforming into warrior women. He had to accept that fact whether he liked it or not.

Kaiden didn’t understand it perfectly well before, but he did now. These three were ready to go to hell for him, just like he was ready to do the same for them. What he did yesterday was akin to spitting on their resolve.
"I will never do this to you again," he decided.
Aria sniffled, after which she looked up into his gaze with her gorgeous, teary eyes. Once she felt he got her point perfectly well, she needily nuzzled her head into his chest and nodded, "Good."
They remained as such for a long time, during which Kaiden stroked her hair and back lovingly.
Once they were done and all grievances were properly addressed, the pair said their goodbyes to Julia and Lux.
It was time to level up!

chapters.title: Chapter 121: Realization
paragraphs: "Hmm... I see how it is." Luna decreed with a strong scowl. She turned her head sideways and refused to meet Kaiden’s gaze. The purple-haired beauty was currently sitting on the couch in their home, with one of her legs crossing the other, and her arms did the same in front of her chest.

Next to her sat a similarly disappointed pink-haired curvaceous bombshell. She also had one leg crossed over the other and her arms crossed in front of her chest, but at least she didn’t refuse to look at Kaiden, who had just finished explaining what had happened when he went to have a chat with Aria’s mother.

"Girls,hemust think of us as mere props who he can use to raise his system’s rank. We’re just hot women to plow and have cooking streams with. Instead of being Sinsworn Valkyries, the system should just call us ’Harem Members,’ I think." Nyx’s words stung Kaiden, who was standing in front of the two girls with a downcast look. The fact that she referenced Kaiden as ’he’ instead of ’Kaiden, ’ ’Kai, ’ or ’Master’ hurt him the most. Even the always cheery Nyx was angry with him.
Aria stood next to him and was observing even his minutest reactions.

Once the pair said goodbye to Lux and Julia in the hospital, they came home to get ready for the upcoming dungeon dive. However, after his talk with Aria, Kaiden felt obligated to inform his other two lovers of his mistake.

Kaiden took a deep breath and then let go of a lengthy torrent of apologies, which boiled down to him understanding the errors of his ways, to him having been arrogant as well as ignorant of their conviction.
Throughout his onslaught of words, Nyx’s smile widened, and by the end, her cheery attitude had returned. "As long as you understand," she said happily, accepting his apology.
Luna, on the other hand, kept scoffing, growling, and frowning cutely alongside his apology. She still refused to meet his gaze and only let go of a "Hmph!" as her reaction to his words.

Aria suddenly spoke up, "But Kai, how did you survive in the first place? I was too angry, worried, and disappointed when I first heard the story, but now that I have heard it for the second time, I can’t help but realize that you shouldn’t have survived. Your Vitality stat is not even close to being high enough to shrug off pistol bullets."
Kaiden smirked. "You girls should pay more attention to your systemic interfaces."
He then used [Silent Casting] to cast [Ravenous Bite]. His fangs elongated to an unnatural degree, gleaming with an ominous shine.

"Wait, what?!" Aria and Nyx shouted together, which forced the final member of the harem to also part her eyelids to look at Kaiden. "What the hell?!" Luna gasped, at which point the smirking Kaiden decided to be a bit cheeky by lunging at the previously strongly pouting girl, grabbing onto her, placing her in his lap, and aiming his fangs at her neck. "B-bastard! Stop it!" Luna shouted while punching him in the face.
"Hehehe! I’ll eat you! The small and weak are always the first ones to fall prey to the hungry predator!" Kaiden laughed manically before getting kicked in the nuts.
After receiving over ten slugs to his face and kicks to his body, Kaiden relented when he pulled his fangs back, ending the spell.
"Hmph!" Luna returned to her state of constant pouting but at least made no move to get off of his lap.
"..." Kaiden winced, doing his best to collect himself before continuing, "As you saw, I got a new spell. We managed to hit the new rank of the system, giving me access to my new sin: Gluttony."
"I can’t believe I forgot to check for a whole day..." Aria murmured.
"Yeah..." Nyx agreed. Her embarrassment was clear for all to see. As a woman who aspired to be awakened for a long time now, she knew this was a big blunder on her part.
"So badass!" Luna declared. She was already busy reading her new spells. "We have to go to the dungeons right now! I must try these baddies out immediately."

Kaiden was happy to see that their earlier theory of the girls unlocking new spells while he gets new sin stances upon ranking the system turned out to be the correct one. This meant their power level as a whole increased dramatically.

He quickly bought a new [Metal Nomad] gearset because the silverback mauler monster completely trashed his previous one. Although it got destroyed, it saved Kaiden’s life. He was happy with its performance; it was the best he could afford for now. The next rarity, which was titled ’uncommon’ was simply out of their budget.

Even though their streams and videos were bringing in good money, they were still very poor by awakened standards. They had 50 Chronos to their name after leasing the new apartment with four bedrooms from Anna’s company and buying his new armor. Luna also bought two more beginner potion sets so that all of them could have one of each potion type (heal, mana, poison-cure) on their persons.
As they made their way towards the dungeon, Kaiden began thinking inwardly about their approach to their upcoming clear.

He knew very well that should he broadcast his and his girls’ new spells to the awakened platform, numerous eyebrows would be raised, including the eyebrows of a select few people who he truly didn’t want to be on the radar of.
However, he had one trump card on his side.
Vespera Ashborn.
He planned to abuse the hell out of her name and reputation of being a cold-blooded murder machine of the highest order.

Kaiden didn’t want to call on her anymore, but he didn’t doubt even for a second that the higher-ups of the government were very well aware of the connection he shared with the woman, thus, they would leave him alone. Hopefully.

It felt a bit bad to rely on her for protection, but the choice came down to either hiding everything he had and living a secretive, obscure life in the shadows or going full throttle down the road leading to stardom.
If Kaiden didn’t have his system and its specific requirements to rank up, he would’ve been more careful. However, as things stood, should he decide to play things safe, he might ruin everything.

Simply leveling up was not going to be satisfactory; he had to do his best to rank the system up as well, which required him to be in the spotlight. Otherwise, his system might leave in search of a new host.
That wasn’t to say Kaiden felt rushed or hated the situation, though. It was the exact opposite, in fact; he loved every bit of it. He wasn’t the type of guy who wanted to stalk in the shadows.

He was grateful both for the existence of the system and his mother’s protective nature. The combination of these two would allow him to soar to heights he could never have achieved with only one of the two by his side.
Thus, he was a hundred percent sold on the plan to broadcast their upcoming dungeon clear as well.
Their approach could be summed up as:
Go big or go home.

chapters.title: Chapter 122: Upgraded Valkyries
paragraphs: As for the dungeon of their choice, it would have to be the same one that they entered beforehand. It was simply the best choice considering their opportunities. When one clears a dungeon that wasn’t explored previously, they can receive drops from slain monsters and also find treasure chests.
However, those dungeons were not open to the public. All dungeons were owned by the United States and its governing body, who would lease the dungeons to contracted guilds.

The only way Kaiden and co could enter a ’virgin’ dungeon was to either create their own guild and pay millions, if not billions of dollars for each dungeon contract, or to swear allegiance to a guild that owned such dungeons.
The former option was simply not feasible for the time being, while the latter was not something Kaiden wanted to do.
Guilds were strict organizations, he wanted to be his own man. Kaiden cherished freedom and independence greatly.

Not joining a guild wasn’t only about his ego, though. Depending on the contract, he could find himself separated from his ladies due to being forced to join different combat teams. Furthermore, their rate of growth would depend on the opportunities the guild decides to give them.

And if this much wasn’t enough of a reason to stay independent, there could be some guild manager who decides to spite him—which was a very real possibility considering he had three gorgeous and loyal girlfriends—the manager could heavily stunt their growth by not sending them on missions or even sending them to their deaths.
Thus, joining a guild was a major no-go for them.

However, Kaiden had already devised a plan that would let them clear fresh dungeons without having to go with either of the aforementioned options, but for that path to become available, they would first need to showcase their strength and competence as combatants, which was the goal of today’s dungeon dive.
"Welcome back to Valhalla’s Sinners, everyone," Kaiden greeted his viewers.
- Princeless Princess: Good luck with today’s stream!
- Kaiden’s Wife: Agh! I was beaten to being the first to comment... Anyways, break a leg!
- Kaiden’s Wife: I didn’t mean it literally!
- Divine Light: I already know that this youngster is a great entertainer and a well-established ladies’ man, but I’m curious to see if he excels as a combatant as well.
- Kaiden’s Wife: Of course he does!
It didn’t take long for the squad to move away from the dungeon gate and find a few stragglers.
<Glowcap Creeper - Level 4>
<Glowcap Creeper - Level 3>
<Glowcap Creeper - Level 4>
<Glowcap Creeper - Level 5>

They were greeted by four monsters that formed a group. These creatures were luminescent mushroom-like entities with extending tentacles. They could fight from medium range, which made them harder opponents than simpler monsters who resembled animals.
Since Kaiden already knew his abilities, he was eager to see what his ladies were capable of.
"I got this, besties," Nyx announced as she stepped forth. Aria eyed her curiously while Luna frowned. It was evident she wanted to go first.

Nyx crouched down to pick up two larger chunks of stone lying on the ground, weighing them in her hands before lifting them from her palms with [Telekinesis], the ability she had unlocked as soon as she became Kaiden’s Sinsworn Valkyrie.

"[Kinetic Shard]." Her spell intonation resulted in the stones shattering into dozens of sharp fragments. With a push of her two hands, the shards shot toward the group of glowcap creepers in the form of a hailstorm made of miniature projectiles.

The luminescent monsters reacted quickly: their glowing tentacles whipped out with great speed. They deflected most of the shards mid-air, and the ones that hit only grazed their tough, rubbery hides, drawing small traces of bioluminescent fluid but failing to cause significant damage.

Nyx eyed the monsters as she evaluated the results of her actions. "I still need to increase my Magic stat if I want such measly projectiles to cause good damage, it seems. For now, I have to rely on greater objects to deal sufficient damage." Once the Space Valkyrie was satisfied with the findings of her analysis, she stretched out her right hand and utilized her second newly unlocked ability. "[Astral Summon: Fire]!"
The air shimmered in front of her, and a strangely transparent blade materialized out of thin air. It pulsed with fiery energy.

This spell allowed the Space Valkyrie to summon a weapon of her choice, and she could also coat it with one of the four basic elements: fire, water, wind, and earth. She elected to go with fire in this instance as these creepers looked a lot like mushrooms, making her assume that fire would be the best counter-element.

The blade shot forward, propelled by her [Telekinesis]. Nyx used all her mental strength to make this projectile traverse through the air as swiftly as she could, and this effort of hers was boosted by her heavy investment into the Magic stat as well.

The targeted glowcap creeper tried to react by flailing its tentacles in a desperate attempt to block the incoming attack, but Nyx’s speed was too much for it. The flaming blade struck true, embedding itself deep in the creature’s spongy body.

Flames erupted from its core, consuming the monster from the inside. It screeched in the form of a wet, gurgling sound, and its glowing form began thrashing wildly as the fire spread across its luminescent flesh. Its bioluminescent shine lost its strength rapidly, and the stench of burning organic matter filled the air.
It didn’t take more than a few moments for the creature to collapse into a smoldering heap as the flames reduced it to a charred husk.
Nyx had guessed its elemental weakness correctly.

The gorgeous pink-haired girl straightened her back proudly while wiping a bead of sweat from her brow. Summoning and controlling the blade had taken a small toll on her energy reserves, but she could continue for a long while. However, it became evident to the Space Valkyrie that she should not neglect the Endurance stat in the future.
"Kreee!" the remaining three creepers screeched as they sent their tentacles at Nyx to eliminate the woman who proved to be a great threat to their lives.

She pushed her arms out towards the incoming attacks and intoned her final newly acquired spell; "[Kinetic Barrier]." A transparent shield formed in front of her body, enveloping Nyx in a protective veil from the direction of the attacks. The tentacles slammed into it only to get repelled.

The creepers continued their assault relentlessly, which resulted in Nyx wincing and gasping while her barrier began showing signs of cracking. If things continued as they were, the shield would break apart.
Before Nyx could mount a counterattack, Luna dashed in front of her and slashed at multiple tentacles with her [Stormblade], tearing them apart immediately.

"You cowkin bitch, you must be assuming you’re the heroine of a deranged hentai. Stop letting these tentacle monsters have their way with you! You’re not in the middle of shooting an adult video, dumbass."

Just as Luna mounted a counterattack, Grace, the secretary of the Awakened Association’s chairman, was rushing towards the aforementioned man to deliver the big news of what she was currently witnessing on the stream of Valhalla’s Sinners.

It was simply the best choice considering their opportunities.
When one clears a dungeon that wasn’t explored previously, they can receive drops from slain monsters and also find treasure chests.
However, those dungeons were not open to the public.
All dungeons were owned by the United States and its governing body, who would lease the dungeons to contracted guilds.

The only way Kaiden and co could enter a ’virgin’ dungeon was to either create their own guild and pay millions, if not billions of dollars for each dungeon contract, or to swear allegiance to a guild that owned such dungeons.
The former option was simply not feasible for the time being, while the latter was not something Kaiden wanted to do.
Guilds were strict organizations, he wanted to be his own man.
Kaiden cherished freedom and independence greatly.
Not joining a guild wasn’t only about his ego, though.
Depending on the contract, he could find himself separated from his ladies due to being forced to join different combat teams.
Furthermore, their rate of growth would depend on the opportunities the guild decides to give them.

And if this much wasn’t enough of a reason to stay independent, there could be some guild manager who decides to spite him—which was a very real possibility considering he had three gorgeous and loyal girlfriends—the manager could heavily stunt their growth by not sending them on missions or even sending them to their deaths.
Thus, joining a guild was a major no-go for them.

"Welcome back to Valhalla’s Sinners, everyone," Kaiden greeted his viewers.

chapters.title: Chapter 123: Badass Girls
paragraphs: Once Luna was done berating Nyx, she equipped a stance with the blade behind her as if she was preparing for some samurai-style quick-draw attack.
It didn’t take her more than a fraction of a second to channel her storm powers as she unleashed [Thunder Slash].

A glowing and crackling shockwave of storm energy burst forth from her blade, slicing through the air in a brilliant streak of lightning. It hit one of the creepers, and the resounding impact detonated, leaving the creature convulsing before falling to the ground.
The remaining two creepers retaliated by whipping their tentacles toward her in a wild frenzy.

Luna smirked, "Aww... They’re kinda cute, maybe we should keep one as our pet. I bet the submissive bimbo would love it." She then sent a meaningful glance toward Kaiden, in which she wordlessly asked how he felt about using his [Monster Girl Subjugation] on one of them.

This skill of his required him to sexually dominate a monster into complete submission, and it only had three charges, meaning he could only subjugate three monsters. Not only was this one too weak for Kaiden’s tastes, but their ugly mushroom-like appearance didn’t manage to get him going, to say the least. Thus, he could only eye the purple-haired beauty wryly, letting her know that her suggestion was denied.
Luna giggled, "Well, then..."
She activated [Lightning Step], which caused her body to vanish in a flash of light as she zipped past them, leaving behind faint traces of electricity.

The enemies twitched and hissed as the charged trail seared them, however, that was the least of their problems because Luna appeared behind one with her blade being mid-swing already. The creeper let out a screech just before it was sliced into clean halves.
The final creeper activated its defensive measures. Now that its enemy was in melee range, it could bring out more of its abilities.
The glowing of its body intensified significantly, flooding the area with a blinding light, after which a sickly green mist began to seep into the air. The aura of poison was unmistakable.

Luna desummoned her blade, and with a snap of her fingers, she conjured [Aero Repulsion], materializing a powerful gust of wind that roared out from her to disperse the toxic cloud and shove the creeper back.

She was not the Electro Valkyrie but the Storm Valkyrie. Lightning was merely part of the storm, not its entirety. Wind played a major role in storms, which was reflected in this wind elemental spell of hers.

The monster was blasted into the air, and before it could land, a silvery projectile shaped like a crescent moon whizzed through the air, piercing the ugly monster cleanly, resulting in a big gaping hole appearing in its body.
Luna’s head snapped in Aria’s direction, who still had her staff aimed directly at the monster she had killed. The purple-haired beauty accused her instantly, "Kill steal!"
"I’m the ranger of the group. You pushing the enemy away from yourself was you asking me to step in, as far as I’m concerned," Aria defended herself.

"Damn, I hit the nail on its head when I cooked up the title of chaos gremlin for you, bestie..." Nyx giggled amusedly while observing the chaotic destruction her friend had caused. She could only imagine how much of a menace Luna would end up becoming when she got stronger.
Before Luna could retort, a new monster’s roar sounded from dangerously close.
<Silverback Mauler - Level 6>
It was the same monster that nearly ended all three of them when they chased after Theodore, who kidnapped Luna.

"Perfect, I always wanted to murder a few of these disgusting creatures..." Aria murmured ominously. Her usual, cheery attitude was nowhere to be seen, replaced by the aura of a bloodthirsty demoness who bore such a great grudge against this entity that it could only be repaid in blood.

"How dare you almost kill my boyfriend?! I’ll make such a nice coat out of your silvery fur Bal*nciaga will come begging me to sign a designer contract!" The fact that it was a different monster of the same kind didn’t seem to bother the girl at all.
The Moon Valkyrie’s unexpected shift in her demeanor made both girls reluctant to intervene in her fight.

Aria unleashed [Crescent Volley], which saw her release a machine-gun-like barrage of small silvery moonlight projectiles. The rapid-fire assault pelted the silverback mauler endlessly, each strike leaving minuscule scorch marks on its thick hide.
However, the monster’s tough exterior, which had previously repelled even Kaiden’s axe slash that was bolstered by [Doom Strike], held firm once again, showing only minor signs of damage.

The silverback growled with fury before its bloodshot eyes locked onto Aria. The monster charged forward like a freight train. Despite its intimidating, rapidly encroaching large frame, Aria didn’t falter; her barrage continued without pause, filling the air with streaks of luminous projectiles.

Crescent Volley was a unique spell in the sense that it could theoretically go on forever. The only thing that prevented that from becoming reality was that each second it was active, it would cost its caster mana.

It became evident she couldn’t stop the monster in time, thus, she activated [Lunar Glide]. Her body lifted ever so slightly off the ground, letting the girl hover in the air an inch or so above the surface. She began to glide backward while still facing the charging silverback.
Aria’s movements were graceful and fluid as if she were skating on an invisible sheet of ice, and throughout it all, her unrelenting volley of projectiles continued, assaulting the enraged monster.

Its fury only seemed to grow as a result, evidenced by the fact it completely ignored the three observers as it rushed past them to catch the annoying little fly that was the Moon Valkyrie in its eyes.
"Hmm..." Aria mused as she analyzed the beast’s sturdy hide. "Its defenses are truly annoying... No wonder we struggled so much back then. However, times have changed."

Her [Crescent Volley] ceased abruptly when she raised her staff, and an intense force began gathering at its tip. The glow kept intensifying from one moment to the next, pulsing with power as she concentrated her mana into her upcoming attack.

The silverback mauler showed no signs of care or sense of danger as it kept charging toward her, determined to reach its prey. Lacking ranged attacks, this was the only combat style it knew. But before it could get too close, Aria cast the charged-up spell, "[Lunar Overload]!"
The spell erupted from the tip of her staff in the form of a massive beam of pure moonlight. The radiant projectile tore through the air and struck the bear square in the face.
Its skull immediately shattered on impact as the powerful energy obliterated its head.

The force behind her attack didn’t stop there; the beam barreled through the rest of its body, leaving a gaping hole through its chest and reducing much of its flesh to ash. What remained of the monster collapsed in a heap. Its body was destroyed beyond recognition.

Aria’s hovering maneuvers came to a halt, and she lowered her staff with a condescending grin visible on her face. She observed her enemy’s gored corpse with hateful eyes for a few seconds before scoffing, "Hmph! This is what happens to bitches who dare hurt my Kai!" A great deal of venom brewed in her voice as a possessiveness gleamed in her eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 124: Yandere Princess
paragraphs: Luna stared at the scene with disbelief. "I thought this serene princess would become a supporter because she wasn’t fit to become an aggressive combatant, but damn. I don’t recognize her at all."

Nyx, who was similarly shocked, yelped while pointing at the Moon Valkyrie, "Look! She even kicked the corpse out of sheer spite! Who the hell is this woman? Where’s the gentle, compassionate girl called Aria?! She went from Disn*y Princess to Yandere Princess!"
"Kai!" Aria cheered as her yandere side was shoved back into the abyssal void.

A brilliant smile adorned her lips as she used the remaining duration of her Lunar Glide to dash into Kaiden’s embrace and nuzzle her head into his chest. Kaiden chuckled at his girlfriend’s antics, he was just as surprised by Aria’s actions as the other two girls were.

However, he was always open to having a sexy schizo yandere GF, so there were no red flags raised in his mind at all. Instead, he began stroking her lush silver hair while assessing the information he managed to gather.

Back when they awakened, he found it strange that he got three spells while his Valkyries only got one each. However, their spells were powerful on their own, while his were rather lackluster on an individual level. [Doom Strike], [Warpath], and [Fiery Burst] were lacking compared to [Telekinesis], [Stormblade], and [Lunar Arc] in a direct comparison.
He thought that the initial spells the ladies unlocked were going to become the core of their classes as they unlocked more of them, and this quickly turned out to be the correct hypothesis.
His Wrath stance might become his trademark ability while the initial spell of the girls would turn out to become theirs, with their new spells depending on that ability in one shape or form.
Two of Nyx’s new spells, namely [Kinetic Shard] and [Astral Summon], depended on her [Telekinesis] to throw the projectiles at her enemies.
Aria’s [Lunar Overload] was just her charging [Lunar Arc] until it overloaded, while Luna’s [Thunder Slash] needed [Stormblade] to be active for it to become useable.
Thus, his hypothesis was that...
Luna would become a melee combatant who used speed and chaos to her advantage to wreak havoc.
Aria would become an orbital mage who unleashed devastation on their enemies.
Nyx would use her dominion over space itself to become a nightmare of a crowd controller who could cause major damage while also protecting her allies, becoming the queen of utility.

Lastly, his Wrath stance would evolve until Kaiden became a walking catastrophe, a pure force of nature as he destroys all who dare stand in his path. This would be assisted by his other stances, such as Gluttony allowing him to regenerate from the wounds he might suffer in the process and also gaining little buffs thanks to [Harvest], the passive ability that picked up orbs when he slayed his enemies.
While Kaiden was musing about these topics, the chat was going absolutely wild.
- Thirsty247: What the heck? All the girls got a power-up! Also, #AriaSupremacy

- Shadow Warrior: I’ll be visiting my doctor, for my eyes are showing me pure nonsense. I must’ve relapsed in my sleep, I even managed to stay clean of the cursed white powder for months! F*ck! Also, #AriaSupremacy
- Lapdog of the Empress: This insignificant one is once again in awe of the Empress! She reigns supreme, as always! #LunaSupremacy
- Divine Light: This senior recommends the young stud not to have any missteps in the relationship... Should he be found lacking, his life might be in grave danger.
- Kaiden’s Wife: The Rosy Knight is not a cheating scumbag!
- TouchGrass: I guess that means you have no chance of being with him.
- Kaiden’s Wife: !!!
- Lady Leia: Kekeke! I don’t mind even if you cheat on me, Kai! Hell, I’ll happily put the green hat on myself and sit in the cuck chair while cheering you on from the sidelines!
- Princeless Princess: Please keep your unhinged fetishes from the chat. We have children in the audience.

- Lady Leia: I don’t think this can be treated as a family-friendly stream when one of the main personalities calls her friend ’cowkin bitch’ and screeches about tentacle hentai. By the by, I totally get it. I would be so down for a freaky session with Kai if he got tentacle powers.
In the meantime, at the HQ of the Awakened Association.
Grace raced down the halls toward the office of the chairman, and she burst through the doors with very little decorum.
The chairman raised a questioning eyebrow in her direction. She wasn’t known for such brash entrances.
"Sir! They got new spells!"
"... Slow down a bit," the chairman spoke up in an attempt to calm the hyperventilating woman down. "Who got new spells?"
"The targets of my surveillance mission! The three Valkyrie-classed women!"
The chairman couldn’t help but frown. "They reached level 25 already? But they just awakened. This is probably a world record."
When one reached and surpassed bottlenecks, the first of which would happen at level 25, they would receive new spells, which was the phenomenon the chairman was referencing.
"No! They’re still in the beginner dungeon, and their stats seem to be that of awakened who are at the beginning of their leveling journey."

The chairman’s frown only increased in intensity upon hearing her words. "So you’re telling me that three awakened just so happened to re-awaken in the same short time frame, all of whom just so happened to be close acquaintances and also happened to have the Valkyrie epithet in their classes?"

Re-awakening was an incredibly rare phenomenon that only occurred to a select few people in the past decade throughout the whole world. Those that re-awakened would receive a new class and abilities. Thus far, all cases resulted in the re-awakener receiving a stronger class than the previous one.

"Sir, I don’t know...!" Grace replied with unease being evident in her tone. These people who she was tasked to observe seemed like normal young adults having fun up until a few minutes ago, but now, they more so resembled aliens than humans in her eyes. "They still have access to their original spells, and the new ones seem to come from the same vein; they are very synergistic. I don’t think they re-awakened; more so, it’s as if they surpassed a bottleneck without reaching level 25!"
The chairman remained silent and unmoving as the gears in his brain moved with alarming speed.
He thought of numerous paths he could take.
These four were by far the most curious case study they had stumbled upon.

If only they could research them extensively, the United States might uncover many secrets of the mana apocalypse. These discoveries could be the key that would let them retain their dangerously fleeting global dominance over the other superpowers who were rapidly catching up to them due to their higher population numbers, which resulted in significantly more citizens awakening.
However, all paths he could think of ended up butting into a horribly unmoving obstacle—the bane of his existence and the most annoying woman he ever had the displeasure of interacting with...
Vespera Ashborn.
"I’ll give her a call..." The chairman said, followed by a tired sigh. The migraine was already making its presence known, and he hadn’t even dialed her number yet.

"I thought this serene princess would become a supporter because she wasn’t fit to become an aggressive combatant, but damn.
I don’t recognize her at all."
Nyx, who was similarly shocked, yelped while pointing at the Moon Valkyrie, "Look!
She even kicked the corpse out of sheer spite!
Who the hell is this woman?
Where’s the gentle, compassionate girl called Aria?!
She went from Disn*y Princess to Yandere Princess!"
"Kai!" Aria cheered as her yandere side was shoved back into the abyssal void.
A brilliant smile adorned her lips as she used the remaining duration of her Lunar Glide to dash into Kaiden’s embrace and nuzzle her head into his chest.
Kaiden chuckled at his girlfriend’s antics, he was just as surprised by Aria’s actions as the other two girls were.
However, he was always open to having a sexy schizo yandere GF, so there were no red flags raised in his mind at all.
Instead, he began stroking her lush silver hair while assessing the information he managed to gather.
Back when they awakened, he found it strange that he got three spells while his Valkyries only got one each.
However, their spells were powerful on their own, while his were rather lackluster on an individual level.
[Doom Strike], [Warpath], and [Fiery Burst] were lacking compared to [Telekinesis], [Stormblade], and [Lunar Arc] in a direct comparison.
He thought that the initial spells the ladies unlocked were going to become the core of their classes as they unlocked more of them, and this quickly turned out to be the correct hypothesis.
His Wrath stance might become his trademark ability while the initial spell of the girls would turn out to become theirs, with their new spells depending on that ability in one shape or form.
Two of Nyx’s new spells, namely [Kinetic Shard] and [Astral Summon], depended on her [Telekinesis] to throw the projectiles at her enemies.
Aria’s [Lunar Overload] was just her charging [Lunar Arc] until it overloaded, while Luna’s [Thunder Slash] needed [Stormblade] to be active for it to become useable.
Thus, his hypothesis was that...
Luna would become a melee combatant who used speed and chaos to her advantage to wreak havoc.
Aria would become an orbital mage who unleashed devastation on their enemies.
Nyx would use her dominion over space itself to become a nightmare of a crowd controller who could cause major damage while also protecting her allies, becoming the queen of utility.
Lastly, his Wrath stance would evolve until Kaiden became a walking catastrophe, a pure force of nature as he destroys all who dare stand in his path.

This would be assisted by his other stances, such as Gluttony allowing him to regenerate from the wounds he might suffer in the process and also gaining little buffs thanks to [Harvest], the passive ability that picked up orbs when he slayed his enemies.
While Kaiden was musing about these topics, the chat was going absolutely wild.
- Thirsty247: What the heck?
All the girls got a power-up!
Also, #AriaSupremacy
- Shadow Warrior: I’ll be visiting my doctor, for my eyes are showing me pure nonsense.
I must’ve relapsed in my sleep, I even managed to stay clean of the cursed white powder for months!
F*ck!
Also, #AriaSupremacy
- Lapdog of the Empress: This insignificant one is once again in awe of the Empress!
She reigns supreme, as always! #LunaSupremacy
- Divine Light: This senior recommends the young stud not to have any missteps in the relationship...
Should he be found lacking, his life might be in grave danger.
- Kaiden’s Wife: The Rosy Knight is not a cheating scumbag!
- TouchGrass: I guess that means you have no chance of being with him.
- Kaiden’s Wife: !!!
- Lady Leia: Kekeke!
I don’t mind even if you cheat on me, Kai!
Hell, I’ll happily put the green hat on myself and sit in the cuck chair while cheering you on from the sidelines!
- Princeless Princess: Please keep your unhinged fetishes from the chat.
We have children in the audience.
- Lady Leia: I don’t think this can be treated as a family-friendly stream when one of the main personalities calls her friend ’cowkin bitch’ and screeches about tentacle hentai.
By the by, I totally get it.
I would be so down for a freaky session with Kai if he got tentacle powers.
In the meantime, at the HQ of the Awakened Association.
Grace raced down the halls toward the office of the chairman, and she burst through the doors with very little decorum.
The chairman raised a questioning eyebrow in her direction.
She wasn’t known for such brash entrances.
"Sir!
They got new spells!"
Slow down a bit," the chairman spoke up in an attempt to calm the hyperventilating woman down.
"Who got new spells?"
"The targets of my surveillance mission!
The three Valkyrie-classed women!"
The chairman couldn’t help but frown.
"They reached level 25 already?
But they just awakened.
This is probably a world record."
When one reached and surpassed bottlenecks, the first of which would happen at level 25, they would receive new spells, which was the phenomenon the chairman was referencing.
"No!
They’re still in the beginner dungeon, and their stats seem to be that of awakened who are at the beginning of their leveling journey."
The chairman’s frown only increased in intensity upon hearing her words.

"So you’re telling me that three awakened just so happened to re-awaken in the same short time frame, all of whom just so happened to be close acquaintances and also happened to have the Valkyrie epithet in their classes?"
Re-awakening was an incredibly rare phenomenon that only occurred to a select few people in the past decade throughout the whole world.
Those that re-awakened would receive a new class and abilities.
Thus far, all cases resulted in the re-awakener receiving a stronger class than the previous one.
"Sir, I don’t know...!" Grace replied with unease being evident in her tone.
These people who she was tasked to observe seemed like normal young adults having fun up until a few minutes ago, but now, they more so resembled aliens than humans in her eyes.
"They still have access to their original spells, and the new ones seem to come from the same vein; they are very synergistic.
I don’t think they re-awakened; more so, it’s as if they surpassed a bottleneck without reaching level 25!"
The chairman remained silent and unmoving as the gears in his brain moved with alarming speed.
He thought of numerous paths he could take.
These four were by far the most curious case study they had stumbled upon.
If only they could research them extensively, the United States might uncover many secrets of the mana apocalypse.

These discoveries could be the key that would let them retain their dangerously fleeting global dominance over the other superpowers who were rapidly catching up to them due to their higher population numbers, which resulted in significantly more citizens awakening.
However, all paths he could think of ended up butting into a horribly unmoving obstacle—the bane of his existence and the most annoying woman he ever had the displeasure of interacting with...
Vespera Ashborn.
"I’ll give her a call..." The chairman said, followed by a tired sigh.
The migraine was already making its presence known, and he hadn’t even dialed her number yet.

chapters.title: Chapter 125: Calling Vespera
paragraphs: Grace managed to calm herself and was now eagerly watching with curious eyes as the chairman lifted his phone to his ears. She would never admit it out loud because she was a loyal and professional secretary, but she was bursting with excitement to hear how this conversation would unfold.

However, the woman became dismayed when she realized she wouldn’t hear the respondent as things stood. Grace was a resourceful, smart woman, though. To solve her problem, she pushed her glasses up before speaking up, "Sir, I believe it to be beneficial to the Awakened Association for me to silently listen in on the conversation. As the person tasked with observing Vespera’s son and his harem, I might catch something meaningful that would fly by your ears without notice."
The chairman eyed her for a mere second before sighing once again and putting the call on speaker mode just before the call connected.
"Miss Ashborn, it’s me. I hope life has been treating you well," The chairman greeted.
"Yes?" Vespera replied to his amicable, gentlemanly greeting with a single, cold word.
"Miss Ashborn, I know that you’re a busy woman, so I’ll skip the formalities."
Not receiving a single word this time around, the chairman fought a sigh back before continuing, "Can I ask what you know about your firstborn son and the recent developments surrounding him?"

For the first time since the call began, Vespera parted her lips to deliver a response that was more than a single syllable; "I’m spending a million dollars a day to fund a team that solely exists to surveil him offline, online, and on the awakened platform, so excuse me, chairman, but you’ll have to be more specific. If I begin detailing all my information—which is not something I would do for you, by the way—this call will never end..." She paused for a moment before clarifying, "Literally. I’m getting updates on the surveillance targets faster than I could convey them."
"Haaah..." The chairman was on a sighing spree today, it seemed. He couldn’t help it; this woman’s control freak nature perfectly collided with her mother bear instincts to create a true monstrosity.

When Vespera disowned Kaiden, he told her to stop stalking him or he’d have to call the cops for a restraining order. Vespera was a mother who wanted to give her son the freedom to pursue whatever he wanted in life, but that didn’t mean she would listen to him.

Just as he could do whatever he wanted, so would she, as far as Vespera was concerned. Therefore, the first thing she did after stepping out of the sushi restaurant was to ignore his words and begin establishing a team with the sole purpose of spying on him and the three ladies.

That being said, Vespera was not going to barge into his life when danger approached; that was not what this was about. She didn’t step in to stop his reckless duel with David where the odds were overwhelmingly stacked against him, and she didn’t even rush to Kaiden’s rescue when he was in the middle of his death battle with the level 5 silverback mauler.
Kaiden was an awakened now, a modern-day warrior.

Vespera firmly believed that battles to the death were the best way for an awakened to become stronger, not just because of large XP gains but because it forged civilians into proper battle-hardened combatants.

Of course, as a loving mother, she was worried for Kaiden’s life—just like a certain little sister who went absolutely ballistic and had to be restrained to not rush to his side during the fight with the silverback mauler monster—but Vespera hardened her heart to let her son pave his own path in life.

Thus, the reason for her spying was not to make his life easy but to safeguard him from nefarious actors of the human species with incredibly high levels and high-tier classes, such as the man who was on the other end of the communication line.
"Miss Ashborn, I’m referring to the current broadcast that can be found on Valhalla’s Sinners."
"Yes?"

’Stop playing dumb, you damned woman! You just admitted to knowing everything there is to know about him!’ These were the thoughts swirling inside the chairman’s head, but he only displayed a tired frown.

That was more than enough to elicit a muted giggle from the ever-observant Grace, who was having a greater time right now than any cinema or theatre could ever provide her with. Her eyes danced with glee as she anticipated the next part of this very entertaining drama.

"He’s running around in the beginner dungeon with new spells under his belt, and the same is true for his three partners. They all underwent something strange, as if they just passed their first bottleneck before even reaching level 5. This is a completely unprecedented phenomenon in the entire decade-long history of the mana apocalypse!" The chairman informed Vespera with all the patience he could gather.
"Okay."
*Crack!*
A fierce vein bulged on the chairman’s forehead as he gripped onto his chair’s armrest by utilizing all the Strength stat he had to his name, which resulted in him pulverizing it entirely.
The chairman closed his eyes as he slowly, deliberately breathed in and out. He repeated it a few more times until he managed to calm himself down.

"Miss Ashborn, I wish to inquire if you would be willing to provide your consent to us re-evaluating their awakened tests. The information we might glean from doing so could be more valuable than any amount of wealth."
"I’m not their manager. I’ve never even spoken to three of their four members. You’re overestimating me, chairman."
"..." The chairman grimaced.

Although his words might seem rather straightforward, they had hidden meanings behind them. Namely, the Awakened Association could legally force awakened individuals to submit themselves to re-testing, but only once a year. As a result, he couldn’t strong-arm the members of Valhalla’s Sinners into re-evaluation for more than 360 days using legal methods.

The association could only ask them nicely, but the chairman understood that any sane person would deny re-testing in their case like their life depended on it, because it most likely did. If the results were to be released, numerous underground organizations would be vying to kidnap him and the girls as curious subjects to study.

Hence, the chairman wasn’t asking Vespera if she would kindly ask Kaiden in his stead to submit himself for a re-testing, but if she would raise hell should the Awakened Association force the four youngsters into doing it, whether they liked it or not.
Vespera’s answer, on the other hand, was that of feigned ignorance, pretending to be clueless. She likely wanted to catch him saying these thoughts out loud so that she could record it.
"Name your price..." the chairman grunted, feeling his nose ready to begin bleeding at a moment’s notice.
"A first-class, one-way ticket to Beijing should do it. Their president did invite me for ’sightseeing’ many times, maybe I should oblige. It’s rude of me to ignore him for so long."

’Here it is!’ Grace cheered inwardly, ’She’s threatening treason on a recorded government line. Vespera is so damn badass!’ Most women tended to look up to an inspiring, heroic person like Scarlet, the awakened with the Flame Monarch title. However, to Grace, Vespera was the most badass woman to have ever existed.
"... I’ll permit you to be present during their re-testing."

A cold, mechanic voice came as a reply. "I once ate curry in a restaurant, but it was horrible. For years, I told myself I would never try it again, but then I realized I was being a close-minded woman, so I visited three more Indian restaurants, but the meal was still terrible.

However, my taste buds are perfect, and curry is a beloved dish all across the globe, so it makes no sense for me to hate it. This train of thought led me to realize it might just be the American cooks who can’t make a good Indian dish or the ingredients become stale by the time they get here. Thus, I was forced to conclude that the only surefire way for me to ascertain whether I like curry or not for good is to visit the origins of the meal to try it as it was meant to."
"Vespera..." the chairman growled.
"Yes?" the woman asked innocently.
