chapters.title: Chapter 144: Illusion
paragraphs: And then, he vanished.Puff, gone. Just like a damned magic trick. One second he was there. The next, he wasn’t. The others caught up and investigated. There was no body left behind.
As for the oasis... It was never there. Just endless sand. "An illusion..." Vaelira growled.
No one had the energy to search for the man. They just accepted the fact that remaining in the group formation was for the best. No one ran ahead after that.

They walked in grim silence. The survivors were few now. Tensions were so thick they could almost choke on them. No one looked at each other besides Kaiden and his girls, afraid of a conflict breaking out. Even the drama queen, Vaelira, had long since given up on picking fights with Kaiden and his team.
Every step forward felt heavier than the last.
They just kept walking.
Because turning back meant crossing the desert again.

But then, from one moment to the next, the sands abruptly shifted, parting away. The pyramid, which had always been on the horizon’s edge like a carrot on a stick, was suddenly right in front of them.
"Thank the gods..." was all that Jack said before stepping forward with shaky legs. What stood before them was heaven itself.
They didn’t even have the energy to stop and marvel at the optical illusion or whatever it was that had taken place. Instead, the group merely stepped inside unceremoniously.
The change that took place in their surroundings felt entirely surreal.

Gone was the scorching sun, the unrelenting heat, and the endless sea of sand. Instead, they stepped into a vast chamber, one that stretched far beyond what should have been possible within the confines of the structure. The air was cool and crisp, creating an unbelievably sharp contrast to the sweltering desert heat outside.
"Finally!" Vaelira exclaimed with an exhausted exhale. She was on her last legs.

Eleven people made it to this point in the dungeon. Kaiden and his Valkyries, Elara, Vaelira and her three minions, as well as their dungeon aide. The only other survivor was Dorothy, the brawler who lost her sister to the dune maw’s surprise attack.

"Let’s set up camp here. We’ll have rotating guard duty." Vaelira followed her exclamation up. The second day was over, and none had the energy to search for a safer place than this. They were likely in the final stretch of the dungeon; the boss monsters they had to eliminate to close the dungeon gate should be hidden inside the pyramid somewhere. But that didn’t mean the whole place was teeming with monsters. It seemed rather peaceful for now.
"How funny would it be if it turned out the boss was in the other direction from the gate...?" Luna laughed with silly giggling, signaling she was likely suffering from a heat stroke.
"I agree." Kaiden nodded at Vaelira while grabbing onto Luna’s shoulder, fearing she might just faint. "I’ll start the guard duty."
He didn’t trust Vaelira’s team one bit, he wouldn’t allow any of them to approach his girls while they were vulnerably sleeping.
"Let’s have two guards, one from each team," Sasha suggested for the same reason.
"Sure," Kaiden said, shrugging his shoulders. Having two battle-ready combatants in case of a monster attack was definitely welcome.
"I’ll start." To his surprise, it was none other than Vaelira who offered to stay awake instead of dozing off, which her body very clearly greatly needed.
Their eyes met for a second, but she quickly averted her gaze and instead addressed her stream, "This is it from me for today; the Vaelira Show will resume in 8 hours."
With that, she reached for her mana camera and turned it off.

"We’ll do the same. Thank you, guys, for all the support today. It was a really tough day, but your encouragement helped all four of us push through this scorched hell. Tomorrow will be a tense push to reach the boss room as we only have one day to clear the dungeon. See you," Kaiden said.
- Princeless Princess: Good luck, and I know you’re very tired, but you should sleep with an eye open! You’re in a dangerous location.
- Lady Leia: If you’re going to be rotating guard duty, make sure the girls are aware of the dangers! I don’t trust these Nova Circuit fuckers, they might try something while you’re sleeping.
- Kaiden’s Wife: The Rosy Knight will, of course, protect his lovers, even if it’s the last thing he does! Isn’t that right, Kai?
"We’re not maidens in distress... Didn’t you bitches see me slice them fugly monsters apart with my badass electric blade?" Luna muttered annoyedly with a vein popping on her forehead.
Before the severely irritated kitten could truly get into a catfight with the fangirls, Kaiden quickly closed the stream after wishing them all a good night/day.
They set up camps far from each other, showcasing just how little the two groups trusted one another. Dorothy joined Vaelira’s camp as she was also a guild member.

Elara quickly raised a tent and began cooking them a refreshing meal before sending the ladies to sleep. A full belly would help them recover better. They only had warmed-up ingredients on them, and the horribly heated water was a drink they never would’ve touched before today, but now, no one even complained.

After dinner, a quick washing session happened, using towels and the same water they used for drinking. It wasn’t very clean nor elegant, but Elara couldn’t carry a whole bathtub on her back. At least she brought soap.

They scheduled their own guard rotation strategically. Luna would go at the same time Leon did. He was their fastest member; only the Storm Valkyrie or Kaiden had the speed to react if he tried something.
Nyx would match Sasha; her [Kinetic Barrier] was the perfect spell to block an arrow shot if she attacked.

Lastly, Aria would guard at the same time Jack did. As a tanker, he was slow and lacked long-range attack options. He could only charge at his targets, to which Aria could react very well and kite him with [Lunar Glide] while shouting, awakening them all.
They all knew that, tired as they all were, vigilance was a must.
With the assignments done for the day, the ladies retreated to the tent while Kaiden stood, grabbing onto his war axe.
When he did, he saw Vaelira smile at him and wave in a friendly manner. She was standing right between the two tents, silently asking him to approach the sort of ’neutral zone’.
Kaiden wasn’t quite sure how to interpret her behavior. She was acting as if nothing had happened over the past two days.
"You know I can restart my stream at a moment’s notice, right?" he grunted, letting her know attacking him wasn’t in her best interest.
Instead of taking offense or snapping at his words, she merely nodded.
There was something strange in her eyes. Fatigue, yes, but also restraint. A flicker of something he couldn’t quite get a proper read on.
Sighing, Kaiden elected to hear just what was going on in that head of hers.
He approached the woman.

chapters.title: Chapter 145: Speaking with Vaelira
paragraphs: Vaelira pulled a small metal case from her coat, flicking it open with a practiced motion. A single cigarette rested between her lips. She plucked another one and held it out to him.
"Smoke?" she offered in a neutral tone.
"No, thanks."

"Suit yourself," she shrugged her shoulders and lit her cigarette, inhaling deeply. "Haaah... I needed this so badly..." she exhaled with utmost satisfaction. Then, the blonde woman looked at Kaiden once again. She sighed. "I’m sorry."
"For?" Kaiden asked with a raised eyebrow, trying to make sense of what was happening.
"For how I treated you. All four of you are doing better than my so-called ’guild mates’ who have been training for years, yet I gave you a great deal of trouble."
"No doubt about that. Why, though?"
"To make the stream more enjoyable. Watching us suffer in the desert heat gets boring quickly... I needed to provide them with some drama."
"I see."
"So I’m not getting your forgiveness?" Vaelira asked wryly.

"No. To hell with your stream numbers. We’re combatants first and entertainers second. By inciting drama in our group, you’ve alienated us from the rest of Nova Circuit. A D-rank dungeon is not your high school playground, Vaelira. You’re not only risking the lives of me and my lovers but also your fellow guild members. Instead of working together to clear this difficult dungeon, we have to watch our backs."
A second sigh escaped her lips. "I wish life was so simple... My parents went all-in on this opportunity; they took out loans to promote my stream. If I don’t make it big, it’ll all be for naught."

Kaiden had to laugh out loud, this conversation was becoming plain ridiculous. "So? What does that change? You’re damned A-tier awakened, Vaelira. Just farm a few levels and sign a contract with a big guild if you’re so worried about money. Financial troubles don’t make what you did today right, in fact, it just makes you an even greedier bitch than I already knew you to be. You endangered human lives to further your streamer career."

"Fine. I’m a pathetic, greedy bitch, I get it..." she exhaled with a big gust of smoke, her eyes unnaturally tired. It was more than mere exhaustion from their harsh day in the desert. There was something deeper there. Years of pressure, bottled frustration, and silent regret pooling in her weary expression.

"The lanky nerdy loser who professed his love for me all those years ago underwent a ridiculous glow-up, created a harem of gorgeous beauties who love him dearly, and he somehow managed to start his journey as an awakened without the backing of a guild... I’m so jealous. Haaah... I should’ve become your girlfriend back then."

Kaiden was surprised by her tone, she was being uncharacteristically genuine for some odd reason. However, he didn’t like her final statement. "If we became an item, I sincerely hope I would’ve become disillusioned with you after getting to know the real you because if I didn’t, I wouldn’t have met these three precious existences. It would’ve been the greatest mistake of my life."
"Heh... You’re not pulling any punches, Kaiden. I’m still a lady, you know? What would you do if I burst into tears?"
"Take a picture, probably."

"Ouch! You truly do hate me, don’t you?" she chuckled, and Kaiden couldn’t help but sense sadness in her tone. She felt miserable. That being said, he didn’t care about her mental well-being because he knew very well she would resume her antagonistic attitude once the cameras started rolling tomorrow morning. As such, even if he made peace with her now, it wouldn’t change anything.
"I don’t hate you enough to kill you even if I could get away without repercussions, but I probably wouldn’t go out of my way to rush to your rescue if you were in danger."
Vaelira winced at his cold asnwer and sighed for the umpteenth time. "How did you do it?"
"Did what?"

"Everything!" she exclaimed. "You awakened after 20, marking you as one of the few truly lucky ones. You won the lottery with a one-in-a-million chance. You also somehow picked up three sexy chicks and managed to create an environment that’s relatively harmonious with them instead of having constant fights out of jealousy. Sharing a partner in the modern, Western world is incredibly taxing on one’s soul. You have an F-tier class yet fight on par with C or even B-tiers! Then what the fuck is going on with your damned camera? Can I buy it off you? I’ll give you literally anything in my possession in exchange," she said with a sultry tone and a glance toward his crotch, telling Kaiden even her body was counted among her offering.
"No, thanks. You’re a pretty girl, but you look a bit like a blonde, evil, and very budget version of Aria. No offense."
"Much taken," Vaelira replied with lips that twitched out of sheer irritation. She was not at all used to being spoken to in such a manner, especially by a man she rejected and then mocked.

However, Kaiden wasn’t bothered. "I was incredibly lucky to awaken and also to meet the girls. As for how we live in harmony, well, Nyx and Luna might like to bicker a lot, but deep down, they’re very good friends. We have a unique bond shared among the four of us. I don’t know what to tell you because your brain that’s always calculating how to give yourself the best outcome wouldn’t understand even if I explained. I honestly don’t think you’ll ever be able to fall genuinely in love. Your greedy mind won’t let you, it’s a waste of opportunity. You’ll just sleep around with S-tier awakened and high-ranking politicians to further your career."
"... We’ll see. Perhaps you’re right," she admitted with another exhausted sigh. The words hung in the air longer than they should have.

The blonde-haired woman was too tired to fight with him or defend her honor. For some reason, getting verbally pummeled felt strangely liberating. She inhaled another puff of smoke and parted her lips, wishing to continue their chatting. But when she did so, only his back welcomed her eyes. He was walking back toward the tent where his girls slumbered, intent on protecting their sleep.
"Douche..." Vaelira scoffed, watching his retreating form with an ashen gaze. Then, with another scoff, she did the same.
The night passed without a single notable event. The girls kept their distance from Vaelira’s guards, letting everyone get some much-needed rest.
Then, they gathered their belongings, started the streams, and got ready to make the final push.

Save for the peace the pyramid granted them at the entrance, the rest of this location was anything but friendly. They’d struggled for hours navigating the unbelievably spacious building. There was some strange space magic present, making it larger than it should’ve been based on the pyramid’s size from the outside.

Sandstorms within enclosed halls, flesh-hungry mummies, necrocarabs, among other monstrosities and traps, had already drained the group’s patience and resources. There were wounds to show for it, both physical and emotional, and yet Kaiden’s party remained steadfast, using teamwork and trust in one another to push through where others might’ve fallen apart. On the bright side, Kaiden and his Valkyries reached level 15 before having to face the boss.
But then, finally, they stepped into a grand chamber with towering pillars and an elevated staircase leading to an ominous golden doorway. Something about this felt place different.
This was the end of the road; they instinctively knew it.
However, that wasn’t all.
The air was thick with an ominous presence.
"Feels like we’re being watched," Luna whispered while glancing around.
"Because we are." Sasha’s voice was hushed as well, her eyes jumping between the shadows of the many pillars.
A heavy silence fell over the group.
Then, with a blur of movement, two figures lunged from behind the pillars. They were towering warriors clad in ornately engraved feline-themed armor, standing at 3 meters (9’8).

The pair landed with the force of crashing boulders, cracking the stone beneath them. Their curved khopesh blades reflected the light like crescent moons, and their glowing amber eyes locked onto the intruders with the pure intent to kill.
Their auras pulsed with ancient rage.
[Royal Guard of the Sun-Kissed – Level 18]
[Royal Guard of the Sun-Kissed – Level 18]

"To make the stream more enjoyable.

I needed to provide them with some drama."
"I see."
"So I’m not getting your forgiveness?" Vaelira asked wryly.

We’re combatants first and entertainers second.

chapters.title: Chapter 146: Twin Royal Guards
paragraphs: Their presence alone was nerve-wracking, letting them all know they were a threat greater than anything they’d faced before. Despite their level not being higher than some of the stronger monsters in the dungeon, it was clear these two were mightier foes.
"Remain in formation!" Vaelira shouted with anxiety. She knew they had no chance to survive should she allow panic to set in.

Before anyone could react, the first knight moved, faster than anything that size should be logically capable of. It swung its blade in a wide arc, forcing the team’s tanker to take one for the team. Jack barely raised his shield in time, but even then, the sheer force sent him flying back.

Leon charged in from the side, gripping his longsword with both hands. He aimed for the knight’s side, but the monster moved with unnatural agility, deflecting his attack with a sharp clang. The impact vibrated through Leon’s arms, momentarily numbing them.
The second knight advanced, its blade slashing downward. Dorothy met it head-on.

A deafening clash rang out as her gauntleted fists slammed into the blade, stopping its descent for only a moment before she was forced back with so much strength her boots carved trails into the stone floor.

"Damn it! Go to hell, monsters!" Dorothy snarled, her face twisted in fury. The weight of grief burned in her veins, fueling her beyond her natural limits. She pushed forward again, ducking beneath the knight’s next swing and retaliating with a devastating uppercut. Her fist crashed against its chest plate, sending a deep echo through the chamber.
But the knight barely staggered.
"Dorothy, coordinate with us!" Kaiden called out. It was hard for the backline to aim their projectiles because she didn’t give them any room.
"Screw that!" she spat, already throwing another punch. "I’ll kill this fucker myself!"
Dorothy’s fist connected again, but the knight didn’t even react this time around. The sheer density of its armor was absurd.
Then it countered. Dorothy wasn’t fast enough to dodge. The khopesh carved through her side.
Blood sprayed from the deep gash as the force of the strike sent her hurtling back, crashing into the stone floor. She coughed blood violently, but she forced herself up with shaky legs.
The knight stepped forward, raising its blade to finish her off.
A blast of wind exploded between them.
"[Aero Repulsion]!"

Luna’s magic pushed the knight back, buying just enough time for Kaiden to rush in, switching to Wrath stance mid-step. The orbs [Harvested] from slain monsters still lingered, granting him temporary buffs. He activated [Doom Strike] as he slammed his axe into the knight’s side.
This time, it reacted.

The impact sent the Royal Guard skidding back, leaving a dent in its armor. Kaiden didn’t let up, following up with a normal strike to the same spot. A thunderous clang echoed through the chamber as his axe bit deep, cracking the golden plate once again.
But the knight refused to fall.

It roared in the form of an eerie, monstrous screech before retaliating with a brutal horizontal swing, forcing Kaiden to block with the shaft of his axe. The sheer force knocked him back, but he remained standing.
"Finish it!" he roared.

Sasha loosed an enchanted arrow, striking the crack Kaiden had made. Aria followed with [Lunar Arc], sending a glowing crescent of energy straight into the weakened armor. Nyx raised both hands as telekinetic energy gathered in her palms before she hurled a massive chunk of broken stone straight at its head.
The knight staggered.
That was all the opening Luna needed.

Electricity crackled as she lunged forward, her [Stormblade] buzzing with raw power characteristic of the chaotic Storm Valkyrie. She slashed diagonally, and her blade sliced clean through the weakened section of its armor. The knight let out a distorted growl as its body convulsed.
Then, with a final jolt of lightning surging through its form, it collapsed.
[You’ve slain Royal Guard of the Sun-Kissed (Level 18)! You’ve gained 5,000 XP.]
[You’ve reached level 16!]
Kaiden turned to the other battle.

Jack was struggling to keep the second knight occupied, his shield was horribly dented from the repeated blows it was tasked to repel. Leon was bloodied, his left arm hanging limp from a vicious counterattack. Sasha was desperately firing arrows, but they were barely slowing it down.
"Enough of this!" Vaelira hissed all of a sudden with evident frustration. She took a deep breath and started moving her wand in an intricate pattern. The ground trembled.
A rift opened in front of her.

From within, dozens of armored warriors emerged. They were not the Roman-themed legion warriors from before. These weren’t weak, disposable puppets but magical knights, wrapped in spectral flame, wielding enchanted weapons.
"[Summon Phantom Vanguard]! Crush this overgrown feline bitch."

The summoned warriors rushed forward, surrounding the Royal Guard in an instant. Swords clashed against golden armor as they forced it into a deadlock. The knight fought with all its might, but the sheer numbers overwhelmed it.

Leon gritted his teeth as he forced his protesting body to activate itself. Even with one arm no longer functional, he refused to stand idly by. He pushed his body to its limits, refusing to sit the battle out.

With a defiant shout, he lunged at just the right time to plunge his blade into the knight’s exposed side, piercing through the cracks formed by the summoned warriors’ relentless assault. The knight shuddered
Vaelira lifted her hand that was holding the wand. The spectral warriors all moved at once, impaling the Royal Guard from every angle.
A low, metallic wail echoed through the chamber before the knight crumbled, its body dissolving into golden dust.
"Did we do it?" Jack grunted with a heaving chest. The battle ended quickly, but it was extremely taxing on his body. "These armored knights must’ve been the final bosses."
The cost of their victory was high.
Leon was barely standing, blood oozed from his arm wound. Dorothy was in an even worse shape, clutching her side while doing her utmost not to faint.
*Shhhhh*
With an eerie sound, the chamber trembled. The once-solid stone beneath them rippled like disturbed water, and the towering pillars groaned as if the entire pyramid itself was shifting.
"You dumb musclebrain just had to jinx it, didn’t you?" Luna cursed at Jack.
Then, the torches lining the chamber flickered, their warm orange glow twisting into an unnatural blue. A deep hum resonated through the air, not from the pyramid itself, but from something greater.
A new presence had made its entrance.
"I see you’ve laid my royal knights to rest..."

The voice was smooth yet authoritative. It had a venomous elegance to it, a melody of contempt and a strong belief of personal supremacy. It echoed through the vast chamber, reverberating in their bones.
From the golden doorway at the top of the staircase,sheemerged.

With each step, her presence grew heavier, suffocating yet mesmerizing. Her form was wrapped in elegant black and gold silks while her tanned skin glowed beneath the blue light. Her piercing, inhumanly bright eyes regarded them with sheer disdain.
She was a predator adorned in regal splendor, an aura of dominion.
The dungeon boss has arrived.

chapters.title: Chapter 147: Bastet, the Sun-Kissed Pharaoh
paragraphs: <Bastet, the Sun-Kissed Pharaoh - Level 20>
Despite only being two levels higher than the Royal Guards, her presence was overwhelming. A true ruler. A living embodiment of the desert’s might.
Kaiden barely had time to process her sight before she moved.

With a graceful motion, she raised a single hand. A sun disk above her head pulsed with golden light, and a burning beam of solar energy lashed out at them, forcing the entire team to scatter before it could incinerate them where they stood. The stone floor melted in its path.

The pyramid shifted. The grand chamber warped, expanding into an endless golden desert. The only things that remained were Bastet, her radiant throne, and the scorching sun looming above. There was no escape.
"This is her domain..." Vaelira muttered.
The monster spoke.

"You dare slay my Royal Guard... and think you will walk free?" Her voice was both serene and deadly, like silk wrapped around a dagger. "By my right as Queen of the Desert, I, Bastet the Sun-Kissed Pharaoh, sentence you to death."
Vaelira reacted first. With a flick of her wand, she unleashed [Summon Grand Phantom Court].
A horde of spectral warriors materialized beside them, a mighty legion of knights, assassins, and warlocks formed from her immense mana expenditure.
Bastet countered immediately.
With a whisper in an ancient tongue, the spirits of long-dead warriors rose from the sands, forming her Ancestral Army. The two spectral forces clashed in a full-scale war.
"We must push forward!" Luna shouted. "Letting the boss monster dictate the pace of the battle will end in our deaths!"
Kaiden knew she was right, so he charged in. The Valkyries followed.
Bastet raised her hand, summoning a sphere of molten gold. It burned so brightly that the air around it distorted from the sheer heat. She hurled it at them.
Kaiden ducked at the last second, the sphere barely missing his head as it exploded behind him. Flames erupted, sand turned to glass, and the force nearly knocked him forward into her waiting blade.
But before she could strike, a storm howled through the chamber.
Luna came in from the side, bringing her blade down on Bastet in a savage arc.

She spun in a blur, catching the strike on her khopesh with a single hand. A brilliant arc of lightning surged through the impact point, but she didn’t flinch. With an effortless motion, she parried Luna’s attack and retaliated with a kick, sending the Storm Valkyrie flying backward.
"Kaiden gritted his teeth but did not slow down. He knew Luna would be able to tank that kick, and he refused to ruin the momentum of their combined assault.
A crescent of moonlight cut through the air.
Aria had already fired. A sharp lunar arc flew toward Bastet at deadly speed, forcing the Sun-Kissed Pharaoh to make a move.
However, she didn’t block. She didn’t need to.

Instead, the feline monster merely tilted her head to the side ever so slightly, letting the arc of moonlight pass just inches from her tanned body. Effortless. Perfect. She was displaying her superiority by toying with them.
"Is this all?" Bastet purred, her voice laced with amusement. She extended her free hand, and the sun disk above her head flared to life once again.
Kaiden’s instincts screamed.
Heat. Pressure. Death.
Before she could unleash whatever devastating spell she was charging, a shimmering barrier of raw force appeared between them.
Bastet’s golden eyes flicked to the side.
Nyx stood at a distance with her arms outstretched, eyes glowing with her spatial powers.
Kinetic Barrier.
The very air seemed to solidify, warping the light around it. A second later, a beam of solar energy shot forth from Bastet’s sun disk, slamming into the barrier with the force of an exploding star.
*Boom!*
The chamber shook as the impact rattled against Nyx’s shield, sparks and golden fire raining in every direction.
Kaiden didn’t waste the chance.
He lunged, pushing his body to the absolute limit. [Doom Strike] was primed, ready to cleave her in half.
This was his moment.
He swung.

Bastet’s body made an unnatural motion as she twisted her torso with inhumane agility, dodging at the last second. While they were in mid-motion, as if time had slowed down during Kaiden’s attack, Bastet’s golden eyes met his.
She smirked.
And with one fluid motion, she kicked at the blade’s shaft, forcing Kaiden off-balance.
Her khopesh flashed toward his exposed ribs.
"Kai!" Luna’s storm-charged blade slashed at Bastet’s side.
Kaiden stumbled back, catching himself just in time. His pulse thundered in his ears. This unnaturally agile, feline monster was stronger than any opponent they had ever fought, bar none.

However, there was one thing he noticed. Bastet never tanked any shots. While it could’ve been explained that an elegant queen wouldn’t want to suffer bruises, if he assumed her to be a monster intent on winning, tanking a few shots to have a better opening for a counterattack would’ve been smart. But she dodged at all times, no matter how little scrape she would’ve suffered. Combined with her extremely potent fire power, Kaiden arrived at the conclusion that this monster wasn’t a damage sponge but a glasscannon.
High Magic and Mana stats, good Strength, Endurance, and Agility, but low Vitality.

In a blur, Bastet sidestepped his axe swing, retaliating with a brutal palm strike. Kaiden was sent flying across the sand. His chest burned with extreme pain where she struck him, alongside his spine, thanks to the painful landing into the rough sand.
[Ding!]
[Sun-Kissed Brand: The target’s body suffers from searing internal heat. Health drains over time.]
"Damn it! She even has debuffs..." he cursed while forcing himself to stand before dashing back into the fray.
Bastet hadn’t stopped. She raised her hands, summoning a sandstorm within the battle.
Thick clouds of golden dust swirled toward them with violent force. Visibility dropped to near zero, and the grains sliced against exposed skin like razors.
"Get behind me!" Jack roared, planting his feet firmly against the shifting ground. He raised his shield.

sentences.text: <Bastet, the Sun-Kissed Pharaoh - Level 20>
Despite only being two levels higher than the Royal Guards, her presence was overwhelming.
A true ruler.
A living embodiment of the desert’s might.
Kaiden barely had time to process her sight before she moved.
With a graceful motion, she raised a single hand.
A sun disk above her head pulsed with golden light, and a burning beam of solar energy lashed out at them, forcing the entire team to scatter before it could incinerate them where they stood.
The stone floor melted in its path.
The pyramid shifted.
The grand chamber warped, expanding into an endless golden desert.
The only things that remained were Bastet, her radiant throne, and the scorching sun looming above.
There was no escape.
"This is her domain..." Vaelira muttered.
The monster spoke.
"You dare slay my Royal Guard... and think you will walk free?" Her voice was both serene and deadly, like silk wrapped around a dagger.
"By my right as Queen of the Desert, I, Bastet the Sun-Kissed Pharaoh, sentence you to death."
Vaelira reacted first.
With a flick of her wand, she unleashed [Summon Grand Phantom Court].
A horde of spectral warriors materialized beside them, a mighty legion of knights, assassins, and warlocks formed from her immense mana expenditure.
Bastet countered immediately.
With a whisper in an ancient tongue, the spirits of long-dead warriors rose from the sands, forming her Ancestral Army.
The two spectral forces clashed in a full-scale war.
"We must push forward!" Luna shouted.
"Letting the boss monster dictate the pace of the battle will end in our deaths!"
Kaiden knew she was right, so he charged in.
The Valkyries followed.
Bastet raised her hand, summoning a sphere of molten gold.
It burned so brightly that the air around it distorted from the sheer heat.
She hurled it at them.
Kaiden ducked at the last second, the sphere barely missing his head as it exploded behind him.
Flames erupted, sand turned to glass, and the force nearly knocked him forward into her waiting blade.
But before she could strike, a storm howled through the chamber.
Luna came in from the side, bringing her blade down on Bastet in a savage arc.
She spun in a blur, catching the strike on her khopesh with a single hand.
A brilliant arc of lightning surged through the impact point, but she didn’t flinch.
With an effortless motion, she parried Luna’s attack and retaliated with a kick, sending the Storm Valkyrie flying backward.
"Kaiden gritted his teeth but did not slow down.
He knew Luna would be able to tank that kick, and he refused to ruin the momentum of their combined assault.
A crescent of moonlight cut through the air.
Aria had already fired.
A sharp lunar arc flew toward Bastet at deadly speed, forcing the Sun-Kissed Pharaoh to make a move.
However, she didn’t block.
She didn’t need to.
Instead, the feline monster merely tilted her head to the side ever so slightly, letting the arc of moonlight pass just inches from her tanned body.
Effortless.
Perfect.
She was displaying her superiority by toying with them.
"Is this all?" Bastet purred, her voice laced with amusement.
She extended her free hand, and the sun disk above her head flared to life once again.
Kaiden’s instincts screamed.
Heat.
Pressure.
Death.
Before she could unleash whatever devastating spell she was charging, a shimmering barrier of raw force appeared between them.
Bastet’s golden eyes flicked to the side.
Nyx stood at a distance with her arms outstretched, eyes glowing with her spatial powers.
Kinetic Barrier.
The very air seemed to solidify, warping the light around it.
A second later, a beam of solar energy shot forth from Bastet’s sun disk, slamming into the barrier with the force of an exploding star.
*Boom!*
The chamber shook as the impact rattled against Nyx’s shield, sparks and golden fire raining in every direction.
Kaiden didn’t waste the chance.
He lunged, pushing his body to the absolute limit.
[Doom Strike] was primed, ready to cleave her in half.
This was his moment.
He swung.
Bastet’s body made an unnatural motion as she twisted her torso with inhumane agility, dodging at the last second.
While they were in mid-motion, as if time had slowed down during Kaiden’s attack, Bastet’s golden eyes met his.
She smirked.
And with one fluid motion, she kicked at the blade’s shaft, forcing Kaiden off-balance.
Her khopesh flashed toward his exposed ribs.
"Kai!" Luna’s storm-charged blade slashed at Bastet’s side.
Kaiden stumbled back, catching himself just in time.
His pulse thundered in his ears.
This unnaturally agile, feline monster was stronger than any opponent they had ever fought, bar none.
However, there was one thing he noticed.
Bastet never tanked any shots.

While it could’ve been explained that an elegant queen wouldn’t want to suffer bruises, if he assumed her to be a monster intent on winning, tanking a few shots to have a better opening for a counterattack would’ve been smart.
But she dodged at all times, no matter how little scrape she would’ve suffered.
Combined with her extremely potent fire power, Kaiden arrived at the conclusion that this monster wasn’t a damage sponge but a glasscannon.
High Magic and Mana stats, good Strength, Endurance, and Agility, but low Vitality.

[Sun-Kissed Brand: The target’s body suffers from searing internal heat.
Health drains over time.]
"Damn it!
She even has debuffs..." he cursed while forcing himself to stand before dashing back into the fray.
Bastet hadn’t stopped.
She raised her hands, summoning a sandstorm within the battle.
Thick clouds of golden dust swirled toward them with violent force.
Visibility dropped to near zero, and the grains sliced against exposed skin like razors.

He raised his shield.

chapters.title: Chapter 148: Boss Battle
paragraphs: "[Aegis Bastion: Divine Bulwark]!"
A translucent sphere of golden energy erupted outward, enveloping Kaiden and the Valkyries in its protective embrace.
The sandstorm raged against the shield, hammering it with unrelenting force, but Jack held firm, his muscles trembling under the strain.
"Don’t... move!" he growled between two strained grunts.
As Kaiden and the others braced themselves within the sanctuary of Jack’s barrier, the battle raged on elsewhere.

Across the chamber, beyond the storm, Vaelira and her remaining team were locked in a brutal fight. She sent Jack to help Valhalla’s Sinners, knowing he lost a bit of usefulness so long as her phantom soldiers were around, ready to tank for them in his stead.
Bastet’s Ancestral Warriors—ethereal figures clad in sunlit armor, wielding spears of golden flame—clashed against Vaelira’s summoned minions.
Leon, whose one arm was already useless, parried a spear thrust at his chest with his longsword. His injured hand trembled under the strain, but he refused to stop.

Dorothy fought with raw fury. Her fists, slick with her own blood, slammed into an enemy’s side, sending it staggering back. But she was slowing. Her breaths came ragged, her body barely holding together.
Sasha loosed an arrow, striking one of the warriors in the head. The summoned being collapsed, dissolving into motes of golden light.
But there were many more ready to take its place.
Vaelira’s eyes blazed with magic. She raised her wand high, her voice ringing out through the chaos.
"Rise, my warriors! Become more than mere echoes! [Imperial Command: Grand Puppeteer’s Edict]!"
The summoned warriors under her control shuddered for a single moment, then glowed with newfound power. Their forms solidified, their weapons sharpened, their movements became faster, deadlier.
With newfound strength, they turned the tide. Vaelira’s soldiers overwhelmed the enemy in coordinated, precise strikes. For every one of hers that fell, two of Bastet’s did.
"Gah!!" Leon gasped.

A spear slashed across his other hand. Blood sprayed. His sword slipped from his grip. He staggered, falling to one knee. "I—I can’t hold it," he panted, staring at his trembling fingers. He had lost the ability to wield his weapon.
Beside him, Dorothy swayed on her feet, her entire side drenched in blood. She wobbled, her body finally reaching its limit. Her vision blurred, and her breath came in weak gasps.
She was about to keel over, being mere seconds away from total collapse.
Leon could barely move his fingers.
Jack was struggling to maintain his barrier.
Despite Vaelira’s might, the tide of battle was shifting back in the Pharaoh’s favor as more and more awakened were running out of either their stamina, mana, or health.
And Bastet knew it.

For the first time since the fight began, she had free rein to do as she wished to the backline, no longer harassed by Kaiden and his pesky squad. Her burning golden eyes flickered across the battlefield, assessing, calculating. They locked onto Vaelira.
The true threat. The Arcane Puppeteer, who had matched her minions, controlled an army and turned the tide of the large-scale fight with her summoned forces.

Bastet’s muscles coiled. Like a streak of sunlight breaking through a storm, she burst forward, closing the distance in an instant. Vaelira barely had a second to react before clawed fingers wrapped around her throat.
"ACK!!"
The sheer force of Bastet’s grip lifted her from the ground.
A burning heat spread through her veins. It was like she was being branded alive. Her vision swam with tears of pain. She tried to lift her wand, but Bastet slammed her into the nearest pillar.
*Crack!*
The impact sent shockwaves through the chamber. Vaelira’s body went limp. Bastet’s grip tightened. Heat gathered in her palm.
A finishing blow was incoming, and Vaelira knew it. She had only one option left.
Her eyes flashed with resolve. "[Puppeteer’s Gambit]!"

The spectral warriors under her command disintegrated, making their essence pour back into her. The injuries Bastet inflicted began to close; her broken bones knitted back together, and the crushing heat in her body dissipated.
Her fingers twitched.
Then, she smiled.
"Not so fast, brownie bitch."
With one final surge of strength, she blasted an arcane wave from her wand, forcing Bastet to release her throat.

The Pharaoh jumped back, dodging the attack. Before the feline could make another move, Sasha took aim. The red-haired archer’s mana-infused arrow screamed through the air, crackling with magical energy. It was a clean shot.
A direct hit.
But Bastet’s hand flicked forward, and from her palm, a burst of sand erupted.
*Wham!*
The projectile bounced off of her summoned grains like a pebble.
Effortless.
"Pathetic."
Sasha’s eyes widened in disbelief.

However... Even the boss monster had underestimated just how far Kaiden was willing to go to secure victory. Vespera’s Ashborn blood was coursing through his veins, refusing to lose no matter what he had to do.

He was already moving, straight through the raging sandstorm. Kaiden sprinted using [Warpath]. Each step was a nightmare. The wind tore at his flesh. Blades of sand sliced his skin open. The scorching heat seared his lungs. His health plummeted.
But he did not stop.
He could not stop.
Bastet still had her back to him.
He switched stances mid-charge.
"[Gluttony Stance: Devouring Strike]!"
Every single essence orb he had harvested from their hours of combat within the pyramid coalesced around his axe.
The blade burned with a deep crimson glow. Kaiden swung for her neck. It was a perfect, fatal strike. An instant kill.
But at the last moment, Bastet’s golden disk flared to life. The artifact shifted in an instant, interposing itself between her and the killing blow. Kaiden’s axe sank deep into the golden construct.
The artifact shattered.
Even still, his blade connected, making a thin trail of blood splatter across the sand.
His [Devouring Strike] activated.

The stolen vitality rushed back into him, closing some of his wounds and ending the debuff she had inflicted upon him. Kaiden straightened his spine. A manic grin stretched across his lips as he lifted his axe to his mouth and licked the blood from the blade.
"Hmm... not bad. So this is how you taste, tanned kitten."
Bastet staggered back, clutching her neck wound. Her face twisted with utter outrage. Her ears jerked, and her tail lashed violently.
Her entire being radiated fury.
She threw her head back as her voice rang through the chamber like a royal decree.
"Y-YOU... YOU INSOLENT, FILTH-TOUCHED, LOWBORN WRETCH! YOU DARE!! YOU DARE TO MAR PERFECTION ITSELF?! TO LAY YOUR UNCLEAN HANDS UPON DIVINITY? TO TASTE WHAT YOU HAVE NO RIGHT TO EVEN LOOK UPON?!"
She trembled with uncontained rage as her eyes blazed with pure hatred and condescension.
The very air quivered under the force of her rage.
"YOU ARE LESS THAN DUST BENEATH MY FEET! LESS THAN THE FLEAS THAT INFEST THE LOWLY JACKALS! YOU ARE NOTHING!"
Her tail snapped behind her like a whip.
"I SHALL NOT SIMPLY KILL YOU! NO! I WILL ERASE YOU! STRIP YOUR VERY EXISTENCE FROM HISTORY ITSELF! I WILL MAKE AN EXAMPLE OF YOU SO THAT NONE MAY EVER—"
Bastet abruptly stopped herself.
Her breathing was ragged.
She realized, with seething horror, that her body was shaking.
She had let this mongrel—this lesserthing—get under her skin.
Her wounded pride screamed louder than the pain in her body.
She seethed.
Then, she exhaled.
She straightened her back, lifting her chin in imperious disdain.
Her lips curled into a sneer.
"Hmph. Very well, cur. You wish to dance with the sun?"
Her golden aura flared.
"Then burn."

chapters.title: Chapter 149: The Puppeteer’s Cruelty
paragraphs: "Don’t you dare count me out just yet! [Marionette]!" Vaelira shouted.

A surge of violet energy burst from her core, spiraling into the air like phantom threads, each one imbued with the raw, untamed power of the arcane. It was a terrifying display of her mastery, a dance of domination woven from pure magic.
Then, those threads latched onto Leon. His body jerked violently like a marionette on strings. His arms were ruined, useless, his every muscle protesting the unseen command, but that didn’t matter.
The strings pulled.
And like a puppet, Leon obeyed.
His broken fingers twitched.
Then, they wrapped around his sword hilt.
Agony ripped through him, a silent wail echoing only in his mind. He tried to scream out loud, but his throat had no voice. Vaelira’s eyes gleamed coldly. "Leon," she whispered, "Swing."
His body moved against his will.
His feet dragged forward, his legs trembling, his ruined arms shaking as he lifted the blade that felt heavier than the world itself.
The edge of his sword clashed against Bastet’s golden khopesh, interrupting her spell.
*Crack!*
As the sound of Leon’s bones snapping reverberated throughout the boss chamber, Bastet recoiled with a snarl.
Vaelira smirked despite the blood trailing down her lips. A cold, triumphant glint danced in her eyes, reflecting her utter control.
She had lived up to her name.
She was no mere summoner.
She was an Arcane Puppeteer.
And all were hers to command.

The sandstorm broke, abruptly dissipating as if it had never been, creating a new reality. The moment Bastet’s focus wavered, her control snapped, making the howling winds vanish in an instant, revealing three figures rushing forward, ready to seize the moment.
Luna’s [Stormblade] crackled with electricity.
Aria’s lunar energy burned in the air.
Nyx’s telekinetic force surged like an invisible tidal wave.
Kaiden didn’t hesitate—his axe rose high into the air.
Bastet staggered, caught between the relentless barrage from all sides.
She barely dodged Aria’s [Crescent Volley], but that left her open for Luna’s [Thunder Slash].
She twisted her body with unnatural agility to avoid it, only for Nyx to slam her against the ground with a towering shield summoned through [Astral Summon: Earth].
Bastet coughed up blood; she suffered a concussion. The metallic taste of iron filled her mouth.
But she refused to tap out. She gathered her strength, trying to stand.
Not caring for any such thought Bastet might’ve had, Kaiden switched to Wrath Stance.
His [Doom Strike] glowed with raw, insatiable thirst for blood.
This was it.
He swung.
The blade fell.
[Ding!]
His body froze mid-motion.
A system notification rang in his very soul.

[The Demonic Pornstar System has detected an elusive race: Ra-Blessed Felinid. Members of this species are wild monsters that undergo a powerful transformation when tamed, evolving into legendary beings that grow alongside their master, having the potential to become world-ending catastrophes.
The Heavenly Demon spent 1,000 years searching for a single one, but he never succeeded.
This is an ultra-rare opportunity. The Demonic Pornstar System recommends the Successor doesn’t waste this chance.]
Kaiden understood instantly, grinning from ear to ear. A wicked, predatory gleam entered his gaze as the implications sank in.
’So you’re telling me... she’s the perfect target for that, huh?’
In the last moment, he switched his grip on the axe’s handle, angling its bladed edge sideways and bonking the boss monster on the head, causing her world to spin.
When Vaelira used Leon to go for the finishing strike, Kaiden parried his blade himself.
"Go treat the wounded. I got this," he instructed before flashing his ladies an apologetic smile.
"I’m requesting your permission," he said while reaching for his scattered Metal Nomad gearset, taking his chestplate off, letting it fall to the ground with a loud thud.
"Seriously, dude?" Luna asked dryly. Her heart was pumped full of adrenaline, this was not the finale she hoped for after such an epic boss fight.
"Hmm... I don’t know..." Aria mused, eyeing the hissing Bastet, who was doing her utmost to collect herself and stand.

"I like this kitty; she’s very sexy, and based on her earlier antics, she is also a very intelligent monster. Though her arrogance needs to be curbed, I’m sure I can leave that to you... Master," Nyx purred, earning herself a ’thank you’ from Kaiden alongside a cocky smile, letting her know she could indeed leave the ’bratty woman correction’ part to him.

The three Valkyries exchanged glances with one another, silently acknowledging the sheer absurdity of what was about to unfold. Yet none of them moved to stop him. They had seen Kaiden do insane things before, but this? This took the cake.
"Haaah... Alright," Luna muttered after a long sigh, putting her [Stormblade] away. The two ladies glanced at the final bastion of resistance.

"You promise you’ll love me as much as before?" Aria asked sheepishly, shocking Kaiden. He didn’t think she would assume his love for her to be capable of dropping even a single iota from ’absolute maximum.’
"Of course I will. ’Till the end of time. No matter what."
Seeing his handsome smile, the Moon Valkyrie’s heart skipped a beat. "Then go for it, Kai!" she squealed with a beaming expression; her worries had been alleviated with a single statement of his.
"You’re too easy, Princess..." Luna grumbled, getting a ’you’re one to talk, Chaos Gremlin. You didn’t even try to protest,’ in return.
"What are you doing?!" Vaelira shouted with frustration, not understanding why Kaiden didn’t let her deal the finishing blow.
"Your comrades are bleeding out; tend to them," he instructed, ignoring her question.
Vaelira’s eyes widened like saucers when she saw this obnoxious man reaching for his shirt, revealing his abs.
"Why are you undressing?!" she screamed, but was utterly ignored this time around.

"The family friendly portion of Valhalla’s Sinners’ stream has ended... Anyone below the age of 18 will be kicked out. Thank you for your patronage, and I hope you enjoyed the stream. See you in our next broadcast. Also, check out our other videos while you wait..." Kaiden announced mechanically like a robot while reaching for his pants and freeing his precious friend from its confines.
"What the fuck are you doing?!!!" Vaelira screamed from the top of her lungs, not having the ability to bear the scene any longer while retaining any semblance of reservation.
"Wow there, easy," Luna slid in next to the Arcane Puppeteer, spanking her behind as if she were a misbehaving donkey. She gestured for Vaelira to put her ear closer to her lips.

As the sound of Leon’s bones snapping reverberated throughout the boss chamber, Bastet recoiled with a snarl.
Vaelira smirked despite the blood trailing down her lips.
A cold, triumphant glint danced in her eyes, reflecting her utter control.
She had lived up to her name.
She was no mere summoner.
She was an Arcane Puppeteer.
And all were hers to command.
The sandstorm broke, abruptly dissipating as if it had never been, creating a new reality.
The moment Bastet’s focus wavered, her control snapped, making the howling winds vanish in an instant, revealing three figures rushing forward, ready to seize the moment.
Luna’s [Stormblade] crackled with electricity.
Aria’s lunar energy burned in the air.
Nyx’s telekinetic force surged like an invisible tidal wave.
Kaiden didn’t hesitate—his axe rose high into the air.
Bastet staggered, caught between the relentless barrage from all sides.
She barely dodged Aria’s [Crescent Volley], but that left her open for Luna’s [Thunder Slash].
She twisted her body with unnatural agility to avoid it, only for Nyx to slam her against the ground with a towering shield summoned through [Astral Summon: Earth].
Bastet coughed up blood; she suffered a concussion.
The metallic taste of iron filled her mouth.
But she refused to tap out.
She gathered her strength, trying to stand.
Not caring for any such thought Bastet might’ve had, Kaiden switched to Wrath Stance.
His [Doom Strike] glowed with raw, insatiable thirst for blood.
This was it.
He swung.
The blade fell.
[Ding!]
His body froze mid-motion.
A system notification rang in his very soul.
[The Demonic Pornstar System has detected an elusive race: Ra-Blessed Felinid.

Members of this species are wild monsters that undergo a powerful transformation when tamed, evolving into legendary beings that grow alongside their master, having the potential to become world-ending catastrophes.
The Heavenly Demon spent 1,000 years searching for a single one, but he never succeeded.
This is an ultra-rare opportunity.
The Demonic Pornstar System recommends the Successor doesn’t waste this chance.]
Kaiden understood instantly, grinning from ear to ear.
A wicked, predatory gleam entered his gaze as the implications sank in.
’So you’re telling me... she’s the perfect target for that, huh?’
In the last moment, he switched his grip on the axe’s handle, angling its bladed edge sideways and bonking the boss monster on the head, causing her world to spin.
When Vaelira used Leon to go for the finishing strike, Kaiden parried his blade himself.
"Go treat the wounded.
I got this," he instructed before flashing his ladies an apologetic smile.
"I’m requesting your permission," he said while reaching for his scattered Metal Nomad gearset, taking his chestplate off, letting it fall to the ground with a loud thud.
"Seriously, dude?" Luna asked dryly.
Her heart was pumped full of adrenaline, this was not the finale she hoped for after such an epic boss fight.
"Hmm...
I don’t know..." Aria mused, eyeing the hissing Bastet, who was doing her utmost to collect herself and stand.
"I like this kitty; she’s very sexy, and based on her earlier antics, she is also a very intelligent monster.
Though her arrogance needs to be curbed, I’m sure I can leave that to you...
Master," Nyx purred, earning herself a ’thank you’ from Kaiden alongside a cocky smile, letting her know she could indeed leave the ’bratty woman correction’ part to him.
The three Valkyries exchanged glances with one another, silently acknowledging the sheer absurdity of what was about to unfold.
Yet none of them moved to stop him.
They had seen Kaiden do insane things before, but this?
This took the cake.
"Haaah...
Alright," Luna muttered after a long sigh, putting her [Stormblade] away.
The two ladies glanced at the final bastion of resistance.
"You promise you’ll love me as much as before?" Aria asked sheepishly, shocking Kaiden.
He didn’t think she would assume his love for her to be capable of dropping even a single iota from ’absolute maximum.’
"Of course I will. ’Till the end of time.
No matter what."
Seeing his handsome smile, the Moon Valkyrie’s heart skipped a beat.
"Then go for it, Kai!" she squealed with a beaming expression; her worries had been alleviated with a single statement of his.
"You’re too easy, Princess..." Luna grumbled, getting a ’you’re one to talk, Chaos Gremlin.
You didn’t even try to protest,’ in return.
"What are you doing?!" Vaelira shouted with frustration, not understanding why Kaiden didn’t let her deal the finishing blow.
"Your comrades are bleeding out; tend to them," he instructed, ignoring her question.
Vaelira’s eyes widened like saucers when she saw this obnoxious man reaching for his shirt, revealing his abs.
"Why are you undressing?!" she screamed, but was utterly ignored this time around.
"The family friendly portion of Valhalla’s Sinners’ stream has ended...
Anyone below the age of 18 will be kicked out.
Thank you for your patronage, and I hope you enjoyed the stream.
See you in our next broadcast.
Also, check out our other videos while you wait..." Kaiden announced mechanically like a robot while reaching for his pants and freeing his precious friend from its confines.
"What the fuck are you doing?!!!" Vaelira screamed from the top of her lungs, not having the ability to bear the scene any longer while retaining any semblance of reservation.
"Wow there, easy," Luna slid in next to the Arcane Puppeteer, spanking her behind as if she were a misbehaving donkey.
She gestured for Vaelira to put her ear closer to her lips.

chapters.title: Chapter 150: Again!
paragraphs: The Storm Valkyrie tip-toed to reach the tall blonde woman’s ears, her voice, usually boisterous, dropped to a conspiratorial hush, and once she did, she whispered, "Kaiden is going to breed this feline bitch. I recommend you pause your stream or something... Don’t wanna anger your sponsors now, do you?"
With that, the purple-haired beauty turned around and left a senselessly mumbling, flabbergasted woman in her wake.

The now buck-naked Kaiden stood a short distance from Bastet, who managed to gather enough strength to get on her knees. The raw, unadulterated power radiating from him was palpable. Despite her efforts, her mind was in shambles, making her limbs refuse to coordinate properly with the rest of her body.

Nevertheless, she let a hateful growl escape her throat as she eyed the large slithering monster dangling freely between the man’s legs. "I’m Bastet the Sun-Kissed! I’ll never submit to you, wretched human!" Her pride, though shattered, remained a fierce, defiant spark. Despite her weakened state, her eyes burned with an indomitable will.

"Yikes." Seeing her sharp fangs, Kaiden couldn’t help but wince with his little brother trembling in unadulterated fear. That boss monster’s mouth was no sheath where he could properly rest his blade, that was most certain.
"!!" But then, an idea struck him like a lightning strike. He’d been hoarding his Upgrade Points all this time, waiting for the perfect moment to splurge.
Right now was that perfect moment, at least according to his ’slightly’ biased mind.
He smirked, excitement coursing through his veins.
[Immune Cock] (D-Tier) Upgrade!
What was a better investment for a man than to make his beloved best buddy sturdier? Losing him would be a devastating tragedy. As such, protecting him was the correct move...
Or so the Paragon of Sin reasoned.
The moment Kaiden selected the upgrade, a golden skill card materialized in his mind’s eye, spinning dramatically in midair like a jackpot wheel at a high-stakes casino.
The card flipped over, transforming before his eyes. A new title blazed across its surface, with the art getting replaced by a metal rod.
[Iron Cock] (C-Tier) Unlocked!
Kaiden shook his head with dissatisfaction before roaring internally and slamming his mental fist down like a gambler doubling down. ’Not enough!!’
The card spun again, glowing hotter, shifting its name and art once more.
[Diamond Cock] (A-Tier) Unlocked!
The RNG nature of the Upgrade Points showed, jumping two tiers all at once.
But his veins bulged from sheer determination. This wasn’t enough! This was life or death! Being a cheapskate when it came to his best buddy would be plain reckless and dumb!
’Again!’ he screamed inwardly with unwavering conviction.
The card exploded in radiance, shifting to an ominous glow. A mighty monster’s battle cry sounded in his mind, marking the awakening of a true calamity.
[Titan Cock] (S-Tier) Unlocked!
Kaiden panted, sweat dripping down his forehead. He had one final Upgrade Point left. His last shot.
Was this enough?
His best friend between his legs quivered in existential crisis.
’No!’ Kaiden gritted his teeth, eyes ablaze. ’Of course not!’
The golden card ignited, spinning so fast it tore through space itself. Trumpets blared victoriously. A cosmic rift opened. The gods themselves peered down in silent curiosity.
The final upgrade revealed itself, shining brighter than the sun itself.
[Omni Cock] (SSS-Tier) UNLOCKED!
[The Absolute Apex of Manhood]

[The Omni Cock is not merely flesh, nor is it bound by the feeble constraints of mortal anatomy. It is an entity unto itself—a singularity of virility, a pillar of untamed supremacy. It exists beyond time, beyond space, beyond the very fabric of reality itself.]

[No weapon can sever it. No force can suppress it. Should its wielder fall, the Omni Cock will endure, suspended in eternity, a monument to the pinnacle of masculine power. Civilizations may rise and crumble, stars may ignite and wither into blackened husks, but the Omni Cock shall remain, untouched by entropy, a beacon of unrelenting potency.]
The world stood still for a moment.
Kaiden exhaled with immense satisfaction.
"Nice..."
His destiny... has been altered.

The moment the final upgrade took hold, a strange, indescribable sensation pulsed deep within him, like an ancient power awakening from dormancy. There was no outward change on his best buddy, no sudden growth or transformation, but internally...
It felt indestructible.

An unwavering core of pure might settled within, a feeling of absolute certainty, as though his manhood had transcended mortal limits. No force in the universe could shake its resolve. It was a foundation as immovable as the mountains, yet as boundless as the cosmos.
For a fleeting moment, Kaiden swore he could hear the echoes of a thousand forgotten warriors nodding in solemn approval.
This was true masculinity.

Kaiden’s head snapped in the feline monster’s direction, and with swagger, he strode toward Bastet. Overwhelming confidence radiated from every step he took. His aura was no longer that of a mere man; it was something far greater.
Primal.

Bastet, still on her knees, snarled at his approach. Unfiltered rage could be seen in her brown eyes. "You dare..." she seethed, her pride as a ruler refusing to bow to any man. Then, in a last act of defiance, she lunged with her fangs bared, aiming to rip away whatever dignity he had alongside his manhood.
She bit down on his large member.
*Crack!*
A sickening sound echoed through the chamber.
But it wasn’t Kaiden who cried out in agony.
Bastet recoiled with a pained yowl, clutching at her jaw with both hands as tremors ran through her body. A look of pure disbelief traversed across her regal features.
Her teeth had met something they could not tear apart. Something unyielding. Something absolute.
Kaiden tilted his head, looking down at the boss monster kneeling between his legs with sheer condescension. A smug smirk was playing on his lips.
"You done, tanned kitten?"
Bastet trembled, unable to properly form words. She glanced up at the human’s face, and for the first time in her life, she was afraid.
